data.name: QueryStockMovementSummary
data.value:
select distinct TAB.Item,
sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'GIN' AND TAB.DocumentType like '%Opening%' then TAB.Quantity else null end ,0))AS OpeningQuantity, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'GIN' AND TAB.DocumentType like '%Opening%' then TAB.TransactionCost else null end ,0))AS OpeningRate, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'GIN' AND TAB.DocumentType like '%Opening%' then TAB.Amount else null end ,0))AS OpeningAmount --UOMName AS Unit, ,sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'GRN' then TAB.Quantity else null end ,0))AS GRNQty, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'GRN' then TAB.TransactionCost else null end ,0))AS GRNRate, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'GRN' then TAB.Amount else null end ,0))AS GRNAmount, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'PRN' then TAB.Quantity else null end ,0))AS PRNQty, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'PRN' then TAB.TransactionCost else null end ,0))AS PRNRate, sum(isnull(case when TAB.TrType = 'PRN' then TAB.Amount else null end ,0))AS PRNAmount
from (
select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item ,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as amount ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,sum( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)as Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,'GIN' as TrType ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType
from dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1
left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID where --[ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/StockGIN_frm.aspx'
--and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @Fromdate
{0} group by INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType
union all
select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item ,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as amount ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,sum( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)as Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,'GRN' as TrType ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType
from dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 --and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType = 'Opening-Site'
INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1
left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID
where [ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/Stock_frm.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
{0} group by INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType
union all
select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item ,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as amount ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,sum( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)as Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,'PRN' as TrType ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType
from dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1
left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1
inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID
where [ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/FinishedGoods.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
{0} group by INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType ) as TAB --where tab.item = '(010110002) M.S TRASH PLATE 38 MM ' group by TAB.Item --,TAB.CategoryName,TAB.DocumentType,TAB.Quantity --,TAB.TrType,TAB.TransactionCost,TAB.amount,TAB.UOMName

data.name: Query_CheckStockForTransferOut
data.value:
select * from ( select case when sum(transactionQuantity) <= 0 then 0 else sum(transactionQuantity) end as Quantity, StockTransactionID, DocumentNo, DocumentTypeID, TransactionDetailID, INV_Item.Description from ( -- For Requisition select sth.CompanyID, sth.PeriodID, sth.StockTransactionID, sth.DocumentNo, sth.DocumentTypeID, std.TransactionDetailID, sth.DocumentDate, reqItem.Description, std.TransactionQuantity, std.TransactionCost, reqItem.ItemID, 'Requisition' as type from INV_StockTransactionHeader sth inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail std on std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID and std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and std.status = 1 and sth.status = 1 and sth.StatusCode = 1 inner join INV_Item reqItem on reqItem.ItemID = std.ItemID --and reqItem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and reqItem.status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType dt on dt.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and dt.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and dt.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and dt.status = 1 and dt.DocumentType like 'Parts Requisition%'
union all
-- For TransferOut select sth.CompanyID, sth.PeriodID, std.SourceHeaderID, std.SourceCode, std.SourceDocumentTypeID, std.SourceLineID, sth.DocumentDate, reqItem.Description, case when std.TransactionQuantity >= 0 then std.TransactionQuantity * -1 else std.TransactionQuantity end TransactionQuantity, std.TransactionCost, reqItem.ItemID, 'Transfer Out' as type from INV_StockTransactionHeader sth inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail std on std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID and std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and std.status = 1 and sth.status = 1 inner join INV_Item reqItem on reqItem.ItemID = std.ItemID --and reqItem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and reqItem.status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType dt on dt.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and dt.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and dt.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and dt.status = 1 and dt.DocumentType like 'Transfer Out%'
) as fintab
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = fintab.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
where StockTransactionID is not null and DocumentNo is not null and DocumentTypeID is not null and TransactionDetailID is not null and fintab.CompanyID = @CompanyID and fintab.PeriodID = @PeriodID group by TransactionDetailID , StockTransactionID ,DocumentNo ,DocumentTypeID ,INV_Item.Description ) tab where tab.Quantity > 0

data.name: Query_CWIPReport
data.value:
select
INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Qty, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ASC) as Row from INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyiD AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyiD AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyiD
LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 Left JOIn SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID AND SET_Location.status=1
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 {0} AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GRN%(fa)%' Order By INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate

data.name: Query_GetPendingStorePurchaseRequisitionReport
data.value:
select INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity as PQuantity, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity, Incurred.Description as Incurred, Abs(ISNULL( ( Select SUM(std.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionHeader sth Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail std on std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID and std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID left Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx') Where std.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and std.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and std.SourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and std.SourceLineID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and std.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and std.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ), 0)) as IssuedQuantity, 0 as GRNQuantity from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx') Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitOfMeasure on SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode Left Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID Left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID left join INV_Item as Incurred ON INV_Item.ItemId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StockRequisitionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
{0} Group By INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Incurred.Description, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode Order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo asc

data.name: Query_Get_GIN_By_DocumentType
data.value: SELECT * FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = @DocumentNo AND Status = 1

data.name: Query_SelectAllGRNCase
data.value:
select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeId,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType --,IsNull(Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced), 0) as InvoiceDtlQuantity ,IsNull(PurchaseInvoice.InvoicedQuantity, 0)as InvoiceDtlQuantity --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as GRNQty FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
--LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail On AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID -- And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID -- And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID -- And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Outer Apply ( select Sum(IsNull(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, 0)) As InvoicedQuantity from AR_InvoiceDetail inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.periodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.periodID where AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0and isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 0 Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderDetailID ) As PurchaseInvoice
{0}
{1} group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,PurchaseInvoice.InvoicedQuantity --having sum(isnull(PurchaseInvoice.InvoicedQuantity,0)) <> sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) ) as TAB --where TAB.GRNQty <> TAB.InvoiceDtlQuantity

data.name: Query_SelectAll__looKUp
data.value:
select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeId,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType --,IsNull(Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced), 0) as InvoiceDtlQuantity ,IsNull(PurchaseInvoice.InvoicedQuantity, 0)as InvoiceDtlQuantity ,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as GRNQty FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
--LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail On AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID -- And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID -- And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID -- And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Outer Apply ( select Sum(IsNull(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, 0)) As InvoicedQuantity from AR_InvoiceDetail inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.periodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.periodID where AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID --And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0and isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 0 and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 --Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID, -- AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderDetailID ) As PurchaseInvoice
{0}
{1} group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,PurchaseInvoice.InvoicedQuantity --having sum(isnull(PurchaseInvoice.InvoicedQuantity,0)) <> sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) ) as TAB --where TAB.GRNQty <> TAB.InvoiceDtlQuantity

data.name: Query_StockTransferNoteReport
data.value:
select row_number() over(order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) as "s.no",Set_DocumentType.DocumentType ,convert(varchar(max),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) as RefrenceNo ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,fromLoc.LocationName as FromLocation, ToLoc.LocationName AS ToLocation ,inv_item.Description as Item , inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo ,ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity , inv_item.ListPricePerUnit as Rate ,ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * inv_item.ListPricePerUnit,0)) as Amount from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Transfer%' --and Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (21,163) Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID left join Set_Location fromLoc on fromLoc.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID and fromLoc.Status=1 left join Set_Location ToLoc on ToLoc.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID and fromLoc.Status=1 --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsTransferred=1 inner join inv_item on inv_item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and inv_item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID inner join inv_Set_Category on inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = inv_item.ItemTypeID -- left join Set_RackItems on Set_RackItems.ItemID = inv_item.ItemID --and Set_RackItems.CompanyID = inv_item.CompanyID left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = Set_RackItems.RackID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%(FA)%' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate AND @DateTo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType Like '%Out%' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} ORDER by Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo

data.name: Query_StoreIssueReport
data.value:
SELECT SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, SET_Location.LocationName, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, '') AS ReqNo, SET_Department.DepartmentName, INV_Item.CodeCombinationID, Incurred.Description as Incurred ,Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) Else isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) END rate ,Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END Amount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx'
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_CostCenter ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_Location ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SET_Location.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Department ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID
left join INV_Item as Incurred ON Incurred.ItemId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND Incurred.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Incurred.Status = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] Item ON Item.[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] --AND Item.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID]
WHERE (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID) And (SET_Department.DepartmentId = @DepartmentID Or @DepartmentID is null) AND ( INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterId = @CostCenterId or @CostCenterId is null) And (INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID =@IncurredOnID or @IncurredOnID is null) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1)

data.name: Query_StoreRecevingNote
data.value:
SELECT SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_Department.departmentName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_Item.CodeCombinationID,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, Incurred.Description as Incurred FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID
Inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID
inner join ApplicationMenu on SET_DocumentType.MenuID = ApplicationMenu.MenuID
inner JOIN SET_Department ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID
inner JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_CostCenter ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 and MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx'
left join INV_Item as Incurred ON Incurred.ItemId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND Incurred.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Incurred.Status = 1
WHERE (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID) AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID =@IncurredOnID or @IncurredOnID is null) AND ( INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterId = @CostCenterId or @CostCenterId is null) and (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1) OR (INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID =@IncurredOnID or @IncurredOnID is null) AND ( INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterId = @CostCenterId or @CostCenterId is null) and (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1)

data.name: Query_StoreRecevingReport
data.value:
SELECT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_Department.DepartmentName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.CodeCombinationID, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, RequisitionHeader.DocumentDate as RQDate , RequisitionHeader.DocumentNO as RQNo,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, Incurred.Description as Incurred, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as DocumentNumber_PO,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as DocumentDate_PO,ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.taxAmount,0)as taxAmount,(INV_StockTransactionHeader.TotalAmount+ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.taxAmount,0)) as TotalAmount,INV_StockTransactionHeader.TotalAmount as Amount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON SET_DocumentType.MenuID = ApplicationMenu.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' left JOIN SET_Department ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID = SET_Department.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID left JOIN SET_CostCenter ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
--Link to Requisition inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionDetail.companyId and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodId = INV_StockTransactionDetail.periodId and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderId and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailId = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineId
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.companyId =AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyId and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID =AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID =AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyId = ap_purchaseOrderDetail.CompanyId And AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodId = ap_purchaseOrderDetail.PeriodId And AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderId = ap_purchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderId and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POdetailId = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POdetailId
left Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader as RequisitionHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo = RequisitionHeader.DocumentNo and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID= RequisitionHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID= RequisitionHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID= RequisitionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionHeaderID= RequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID
left join INV_Item as Incurred ON INV_Item.ItemId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (SET_Department.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) AND ( AR_SET_Customer.CustomerId = @Supplierid OR @Supplierid IS NULL) AND ( INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterId = @CostCenterId or @CostCenterId is null) And (INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID =@IncurredOnID or @IncurredOnID is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
