SELECT CAST(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS varchar(50)) + '-' + SET_DocumentType.DocumentType + '- (' + INV_Item.Description + ')' AS DocumentNoType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID --INV_Item ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND
WHERE (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%transfer%out%(fa)%') AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @periodid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1)
and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID not In ( Select isnull(TransactionDetailID,0) from FA_AssetInformation)
ORDER BY INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate

data.name: Query_Select_ForGIN
data.value: SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Item.Description as ItemDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity2, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReasonLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DistributionAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.OldItemPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EstimatedPOItemPrice, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QuantityAdjusted, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EmployeeCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.VendorLotNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShipmentNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.WayBillAirBill, INV_StockTransactionDetail.FreightCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoofContainers, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PercentageChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReservationLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID, Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsDone, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) ) LastConsumption, ( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID as DocumentTypeID, Item.Description as IncurredDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsIncurred, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks, Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName as Location, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost , Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as CustomAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 order by INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID asc

data.name: Query_CWIP_TransferOutHeader
data.value:
SELECT CAST(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS varchar(50)) + '-' + SET_DocumentType.DocumentType DocumentNoType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID
WHERE (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%transfer%out%(fa)%') AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @periodid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1)
ORDER BY INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate

data.name: Query_ControlSheet
data.value:
select distinct TAB.SPR_Unit , TAB.SPR_Date, Inv_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode AS ItemCode , Inv_Item.Description AS ItemName,TAB.MaterialReq_Date, TAB.QutationRecvDate,PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate as ComparativeDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PO_Number , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier ,TAB.ChallanNo,TAB.ChallanDate , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate as lastRate , AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, case when ap_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID is null then 'Un-Paid' else 'Paid' end as BillPaid , TAB.Remarls, TAb.CompanyID,TAB.PeriodID, TAB.GroupName
from ( select distinct 'Requisition' as DocType, null as QutationRecvDate ,Set_Documenttype.DocumentType,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS SPR_Unit ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS SPR_Date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS MaterialReq_Date , '' as ChallanNo,null as ChallanDate, '' as LastSupplier , '' as Remarls,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName
from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join Set_Documenttype on Set_Documenttype.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_Documenttype.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_Documenttype.periodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.periodID and Set_Documenttype.MenuID =(select MenuID from applicationMenu where menuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx') {0}
LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
) AS TAB LEFT join INV_StockTransactiondetail on INV_StockTransactiondetail.StockTransactionID = TAB.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactiondetail.CompanyID = TAB.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactiondetail.PeriodID = TAB.PeriodID inner join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.ItemID --and Inv_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.CompanyID
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionDetailID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.TransactionDetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.PeriodID left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID ----and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join PUR_EnquiryHeader on PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_Inv_StockTransactionID = TAB.StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = TAB.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = TAB.PeriodID left join PUR_QuotationHeader on PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID and PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID LEFT join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left join ap_PaymentHeader on ap_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and ap_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
where TAB.SPR_Date between @FromDate and @Todate and TAB.PeriodID = @PeriodID and TAB.CompanyID = @CompanyID order by TAB.SPR_Unit
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GRN
select distinct TAB.SPR_Unit AS GRN_NO , TAB.SPR_Date AS GRN_Date, Inv_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode AS ItemCode ,TAB.QutationRecvDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PO_Number ,TAB.ChallanNo,TAB.ChallanDate , INV_StockTransactiondetail.TransactionCost as lastRate , --AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, TAB.Remarls, TAB.Comments, TaB.GroupName
from (
select distinct 'GRN' as DocType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as QutationRecvDate ,Set_Documenttype.DocumentType,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS SPR_Unit ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS SPR_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS MaterialReq_Date ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, '' as LastSupplier , '' as Remarls --AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS LastSupplier ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join Set_Documenttype on Set_Documenttype.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_Documenttype.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_Documenttype.periodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.periodID and Set_Documenttype.MenuID =(select MenuID from applicationMenu where menuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx') {0} LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And ) AS TAB inner join INV_StockTransactiondetail on INV_StockTransactiondetail.StockTransactionID = TAB.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactiondetail.CompanyID = TAB.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactiondetail.PeriodID = TAB.PeriodID inner join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.ItemID --and Inv_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.CompanyID
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionDetailID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.TransactionDetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactiondetail.PeriodID left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join PUR_EnquiryHeader on PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_Inv_StockTransactionID = TAB.StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = TAB.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = TAB.PeriodID left join PUR_QuotationHeader on PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID and PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join ap_PaymentHeader on ap_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and ap_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
where TAB.SPR_Date between @FromDate and @Todate and TAB.PeriodID = @PeriodID and TAB.CompanyID = @CompanyID order by TAB.SPR_Unit

data.name: Query_CWIPTransferOutInFA
data.value:
SELECT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,CAST(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS varchar(50)) + '-' + SET_DocumentType.DocumentType + '- (' + INV_Item.Description + ')' AS DocumentNoType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID
WHERE (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%transfer%out%(fa)%') AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @periodid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1)
and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID In ( Select isnull(TransactionDetailID,0) from FA_AssetInformation)
ORDER BY INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate

data.name: Query_CWIP_TransferOutHeaderA
data.value:
SELECT distinct CAST(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS varchar(50)) + '-' + SET_DocumentType.DocumentType DocumentNoType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID WHERE (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%transfer%out%(fa)%') AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @periodid) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1) and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID not in (select isnull(TransactionDetailID,0) from FA_AssetInformation)

data.name: Query_GoodsReceiveNote_Imported
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo,AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo as RequisitionNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo DCNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate DC_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as PONo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as GRNDate, [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [SET_Location].[LocationName], isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemDescription,[INV_Item].[Description]) as [Description], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ActualReceivedQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CustomDuty ,OtherCharges ,ClearingCharges ,ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus ,abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].RejectedQuantity) as RejectedQuantity ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) when null then 'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) end ) as GRNNumber
FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader POH on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = POH.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = POH.DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = POH.TypeCode
Inner Join INV_Item POItem ON --POItem.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And POItem.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID Inner Join INV_SET_Category POCategory On (POCategory.CategoryID = POItem.ItemTypeID) --AND POCategory.CompanyID = POItem.CompanyID
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%Stock_frm.aspx%')

data.name: Query_ProcurementTracking
data.value: Select Distinct RequisitionDocument.DocumentType As ReqDocumentType, RequisitionHeader.DocumentDate As ReqDate, RequisitionHeader.DocumentNo As ReqNo, GINDocument.DocumentType As GINDocument, GINHeader.DocumentDate As GINDate, GINHeader.DocumentNo As GINNo, RFQDocument.DocumentType As RFQDocument, RFQHeader.EnquiryDate As RFQDate, RFQHeader.DocumentNo As RFQNo, Case when PODocument.DocumentType is null then DirectPODocType.DocumentType else PODocument.DocumentType end As PODocument, Case when AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate is null then DirectPO.DocumentDate else AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate end As PODate, Case when AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber is null then DirectPO.DocumentNumber else AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber end As PONo, Case when GRNDocument.DocumentType is null then GRNDocumentDirect.DocumentType else GRNDocument.DocumentType end As GRNDocument, Case when GRNHeader.DocumentDate is null then GRNHeaderDirect.DocumentDate else GRNHeader.DocumentDate end As GRNDate, Case when GRNHeader.DocumentNo is null then GRNHeaderDirect.DocumentNo else GRNHeader.DocumentNo end As GRNNo From Inv_StockTransactionHeader As RequisitionHeader Inner Join Set_DocumentType As RequisitionDocument On RequisitionDocument.CompanyID = RequisitionHeader.CompanyID And RequisitionDocument.PeriodID = RequisitionHeader.PeriodID And RequisitionDocument.DocumentTypeID = RequisitionHeader.DocumentTypeID Inner Join ApplicationMenu As RequisitionMenu On RequisitionMenu.MenuID = RequisitionDocument.MenuID And RequisitionMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx' Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail As RequisitionDetail On RequisitionDetail.CompanyID = RequisitionHeader.CompanyID And RequisitionDetail.PeriodID = RequisitionHeader.PeriodID And RequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID = RequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID And RequisitionDetail.Status = 1 -- GIN Left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail As GINDetail On RequisitionDetail.CompanyID = GINDetail.CompanyID And RequisitionDetail.PeriodID = GINDetail.PeriodID And RequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID = GINDetail.SourceHeaderID And RequisitionDetail.TransactionDetailID = GINDetail.SourceLineID And RequisitionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GINDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID And RequisitionHeader.DocumentNo = GINDetail.SourceCode And GINDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader As GINHeader On GINDetail.CompanyID = GINHeader.CompanyID And GINDetail.PeriodID = GINHeader.PeriodID And GINDetail.StockTransactionID = GINHeader.StockTransactionID And GINHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_DocumentType As GINDocument On GINDocument.CompanyID = GINHeader.CompanyID And GINDocument.PeriodID = GINHeader.PeriodID And GINDocument.DocumentTypeID = GINHeader.DocumentTypeID Left Join ApplicationMenu As GINMenu On GINMenu.MenuID = GINDocument.MenuID And GINMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' -- RFQ Left Join Pur_EnquiryHeader As RFQHeader On RFQHeader.CompanyID = RequisitionHeader.CompanyID And RFQHeader.PeriodID = RequisitionHeader.PeriodID And RFQHeader.FK_Inv_StockTransactionID = RequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID And RFQHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_DocumentType As RFQDocument On RFQDocument.CompanyID = RFQHeader.CompanyID And RFQDocument.PeriodID = RFQHeader.PeriodID And RFQDocument.DocumentTypeID = RFQHeader.DocumentTypeID Left Join Pur_EnquiryDetail As RFQDetail On RFQDetail.CompanyID = RFQHeader.CompanyID And RFQDetail.PeriodID = RFQHeader.PeriodID And RFQDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = RFQHeader.EnquiryID And RFQDetail.Status = 1 -- Quotation Left Join Pur_QuotationDetail On Pur_QuotationDetail.CompanyID = RFQDetail.CompanyID And Pur_QuotationDetail.PeriodID = RFQDetail.PeriodID And Pur_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = RFQDetail.EnquiryHeaderID And Pur_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID = RFQDetail.EnquiryDetailID And Pur_QuotationDetail.Status = 1 -- Purchase Order -- Normal Scenario Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = Pur_QuotationDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = Pur_QuotationDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FromHeaderID = Pur_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FromDetailID = Pur_QuotationDetail.QuotationDetailID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_DocumentType As PODocument On PODocument.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And PODocument.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And PODocument.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode -- Direct PO Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader DirectPO On DirectPO.CompanyID = RequisitionHeader.CompanyID And DirectPO.PeriodID = RequisitionHeader.PeriodID And DirectPO.StockRequisitionID = RequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID And DirectPO.Status = 1 Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail DirectPODetail On DirectPODetail.CompanyID = DirectPO.CompanyID And DirectPODetail.PeriodID = DirectPO.PeriodID And DirectPODetail.POHeaderID = DirectPO.POHeaderID Left Join Set_DocumentType DirectPODocType On DirectPODocType.CompanyID = DirectPO.CompanyID And DirectPODocType.PeriodID = DirectPO.PeriodID And DirectPODocType.DocumentTypeID = DirectPO.TypeCode And DirectPODocType.groupid=@documentGroupID -- GRN -- Normal Flow Left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail As GRNDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = GRNDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = GRNDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = GRNDetail.SourceHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = GRNDetail.SourceLineID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = GRNDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = GRNDetail.SourceCode And GRNDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader As GRNHeader On GRNDetail.CompanyID = GRNHeader.CompanyID And GRNDetail.PeriodID = GRNHeader.PeriodID And GRNDetail.StockTransactionID = GRNHeader.StockTransactionID And GRNHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Set_DocumentType As GRNDocument On GRNHeader.CompanyID = GRNDocument.CompanyID And GRNHeader.PeriodID = GRNDocument.PeriodID And GRNHeader.DocumentTypeID = GRNDocument.DocumentTypeID Left Join ApplicationMenu As GRNMenu On GRNMenu.MenuID = GRNDocument.MenuID And GRNMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' -- From Direct PO Left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail As GRNDetailDirect On DirectPODetail.CompanyID = GRNDetailDirect.CompanyID And DirectPODetail.PeriodID = GRNDetailDirect.PeriodID And DirectPODetail.POHeaderID = GRNDetailDirect.SourceHeaderID And DirectPODetail.PODetailID = GRNDetailDirect.SourceLineID And DirectPO.TypeCode = GRNDetailDirect.SourceDocumentTypeID And DirectPO.DocumentNumber = GRNDetailDirect.SourceCode And GRNDetailDirect.Status = 1 Left Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader As GRNHeaderDirect On GRNDetailDirect.CompanyID = GRNHeaderDirect.CompanyID And GRNDetailDirect.PeriodID = GRNHeaderDirect.PeriodID And GRNDetailDirect.StockTransactionID = GRNHeaderDirect.StockTransactionID And GRNHeaderDirect.Status = 1 Left Join Set_DocumentType As GRNDocumentDirect On GRNHeaderDirect.CompanyID = GRNDocumentDirect.CompanyID And GRNHeaderDirect.PeriodID = GRNDocumentDirect.PeriodID And GRNHeaderDirect.DocumentTypeID = GRNDocumentDirect.DocumentTypeID Left Join ApplicationMenu As GRNMenuDirect On GRNMenuDirect.MenuID = GRNDocumentDirect.MenuID And GRNMenuDirect.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' Where RequisitionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And RequisitionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And RequisitionHeader.Status = 1 And RequisitionHeader.StatusCode = 1

data.name: Query_ItemTransferRreport
data.value:
select (Set_DocumentType.DocumentType + '-' + convert(varchar(max),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo)) as RefrenceNo, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate , INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments as Remarks ,fromLoc.LocationName AS ToLocation , ToLoc.LocationName AS FromLocation -- ,SET_Rack.RackName ,inv_Set_Category.CategoryName ,inv_item.Description as Item , inv_item.InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo ,ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity , inv_item.ListPricePerUnit as Rate ,ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) * isnull(inv_item.ListPricePerUnit,0) as Amount from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Transfer%' --and Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (21,163) Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID left join Set_Location fromLoc on fromLoc.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID and fromLoc.Status=1
inner join inv_item on inv_item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and inv_item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID inner join inv_Set_Category on inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = inv_item.ItemTypeID --
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join INV_StockTransactionHeader trnferOut on trnferOut.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and trnferOut.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID left join Set_Location ToLoc on ToLoc.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID and ToLoc.Status=1
--left join Set_RackItems on Set_RackItems.ItemID = inv_item.ItemID --and Set_RackItems.CompanyID = inv_item.CompanyID --left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = Set_RackItems.RackID where INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @Todate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID
and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentType
{0}

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging_ForApprove_Copy3
data.value:
Select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ApprovalData.StockTransactionID desc) AS 'Row' From ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedBy ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator ,Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID AS UserID ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName --,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel ,isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and Set_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 order by DocumentApproveID desc ),INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue) as lastApproval,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo as RequisitionNo FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode
LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 )
Inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL)
Left join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status=1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left Join AR_SET_Customer On AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {filter}
) as ApprovalData

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_ForApprove
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedBy ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID ,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel ,AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo as RequisitionNo FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode
LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging_ForApprove_Copy2
data.value: Select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ApprovalData.StockTransactionID desc) AS 'Row' From ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedBy ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID ,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND CAST(SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo as int) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 {filter}) as ApprovalData

data.value: Select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ApprovalData.StockTransactionID desc) AS 'Row' From ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= isnull(SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom,0) THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND ( SELECT sth.TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) {filter}) as ApprovalData

data.value: SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.TotalAmount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo,CostCenterTo.CostCenterName As CostCenterTo, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ShelfReference, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IssuanceType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ProductRecipeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ProductQuantity, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsReversed, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalDate, Set_Department.DepartmentName, Set_Location.LocationName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Loan_COGSAmount,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Loan_StockAmount,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Loan_TransactionType ,LoadingCharges,INV_StockTransactionHeader.ContractorID ,Contractor.CustomerName as ContractorName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.ImporterID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.TransporterID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.TransportationCharges, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsDirectStock,INV_StockTransactionHeader.HeadingCostCenterID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DemandType ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.SeasonType FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location On Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Contractor ON Contractor.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ContractorID AND Contractor.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Contractor.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Contractor.Status = 1 WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_ForRFQLookup
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_INV_StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID in ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = (SELECT MenuID FROM ApplicationMenu WHERE MenuPath = '/inventory/transaction/stockrequistion_frm.aspx') AND SET_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 ) AND ISNULL( ( select SUM(stdet.TransactionQuantity) FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sthead INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail stdet ON stdet.StockTransactionID = sthead.StockTransactionID AND stdet.CompanyID = sthead.CompanyID AND stdet.PeriodID = sthead.PeriodID WHERE sthead.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ), 0) <> ISNULL( ( select SUM(eqdet.Quantity) FROM PUR_EnquiryHeader eqhead LEFT JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail eqdet ON eqdet.EnquiryHeaderID = eqhead.EnquiryID AND eqdet.CompanyID = eqhead.CompanyID AND eqdet.PeriodID = eqhead.PeriodID WHERE eqhead.FK_INV_StockTransactionID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_INV_StockTransactionID ), 0)

data.name: query_Select_DataByKey_ForApprove
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAmountID ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) as TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT abs(isnull(sth.TotalAmount,0)) as TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1
INNER JOIN aspnet_UsersInRoles On aspnet_UsersInRoles.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy And (aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID or SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID is null)
WHERE --SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator = 'AND' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = @DocumentNo

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPendingSR
data.value:
with cte as ( Select INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID , INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, sum(abs(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.transactionquantity,0)))transactionquantity from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' and sourceheaderid is not null group by INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID having sum(abs(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.transactionquantity,0)))>0 ) SELECT DISTINCT (convert(varchar(100),INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) +',' + convert(varchar(100),STD.TransactionDetailID)) StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, ISnull(SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,'') as CostCenterName , Inv_ITEM.description as Item,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail STD on STD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND STD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND STD.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner JOIN Inv_ITEM ON Inv_ITEM.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND Inv_ITEM.companyid = STD.companyid AND Inv_ITEM.Status = 1 Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx' LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID left join cte on cte.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID and cte.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and cte.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and cte.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID {wherefilter} GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, Inv_ITEM.description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,std.StockTransactionID,STD.TransactionDetailID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID,STD.TransactionDetailID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,cte.transactionquantity,std.TransactionQuantity having round(sum(std.TransactionQuantity),2) > round(sum(isnull(cte.transactionquantity,0)),2)
order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate desc

data.name: Query_GetStorePurchaseRequisitionReport
data.value: select INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx') Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitOfMeasure on SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode Left Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID Left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID

AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID, INV_Item.Description, Set_Department.DepartmentName, Set_Location.LocationName , INV_StockTransactionHeader.FreightFC, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ExchangeRate , INV_StockTransactionHeader.FreightFCXExchangeRate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.InwardGatePass, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BiltyNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.BiltyDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.VehicleNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID data.name: Query_CheckRequisitionQuantity
data.value:
select ISNULL(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL(( select SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionHeader STHGIN inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = STHGIN.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = STHGIN.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = STHGIN.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = STHGIN.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = STHGIN.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = STHGIN.PeriodID inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID and MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx'
where STHGIN.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and STHGIN.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and STHGIN.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ),0) - ISNULL( (select SUM(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID= AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join PUR_QuotationHeader on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FromHeaderID and PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join PUR_EnquiryHeader Enquiry on Enquiry.EnquiryID = PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID and Enquiry.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID and Enquiry.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Enquiry.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID) ,0) ,0) as balance
from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID and MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx'
Inner Join PUR_EnquiryHeader on PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_INV_StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
where PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = @RequisitionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID

data.name: Query_GetGINRecordsForStockReturn
data.value:
Select INV_stockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.JobID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.JobCode, INV_Item.[Description] + ' - ' + '('+ INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +')' as [Description], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], -- ( -- select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else std.TransactionQuantity END), 0) -- As SumOfQuantityInStock -- from INV_StockTransactionDetail std --Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader sth On sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID -- AND sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID -- And std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID --Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID -- And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID -- where std.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID And std.CompanyID = 1 -- And std.PeriodID = 1 And std.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' -- ) As LocationStock, abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select IsNull(Sum(std.TransactionQuantity), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail std Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader sth On sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID inner Join ApplicationMenu As GINMenu On GINMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID And GINMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx' where std.CompanyID = @CompanyID And std.PeriodID = @PeriodID And std.Status = 1 and std.itemID = INV_Item.itemID AND std.SourceHeaderID = @StockTransactionID) As LocationStock , INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as IssuedQuantity, 0 as ReturnedQuantity, ( select IsNull(Sum(std.TransactionQuantity), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail std Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader sth On sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID inner Join ApplicationMenu As GINMenu On GINMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID And GINMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx' where std.CompanyID = @CompanyID And std.PeriodID = @PeriodID And std.Status = 1 and std.itemID = INV_Item.itemID AND std.SourceHeaderID = @StockTransactionID) as AlreadyReturnedQuantity, INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, (INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID as SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID as SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO AS SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, INV_stockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, INV_stockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, (Select top 1 SET_Rack.RackID from Set_RackItems left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID=Set_RackItems.RackID where Set_RackItems.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and SET_Rack.Status = 1) as RackID ,(Select top 1 SET_Rack.RackName from Set_RackItems left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID=Set_RackItems.RackID where Set_RackItems.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and SET_Rack.Status = 1) as RackName
,'' as Action From INV_stockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_stockTransactionDetail ON INV_stockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = INV_stockTransactionDetail.[TransactionUOMID]
WHERE INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID

,[CastingSpeed] ,[MoldLife] ,[TandishTemperature] ,[SequenceLength] ,[InletWaterTerm] ,[MetalLoss] ,[StartTimeCCM] ,[EndTimeCCM] ,[FurnaceStartTime] ,[FurnaceEndTime] SourceType ,Length,Width,UnitWeight,INV_ItemDetails.Composition,INV_ItemDetails.KnittingMethod,INV_ItemDetails.PackType
