SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Item.Description as ItemDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity2, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReasonLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DistributionAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.OldItemPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EstimatedPOItemPrice, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QuantityAdjusted, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EmployeeCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.VendorLotNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShipmentNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.WayBillAirBill, INV_StockTransactionDetail.FreightCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoofContainers, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PercentageChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReservationLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID, Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, -- (Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then --ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) -- Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) -- END) Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsDone, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) ) LastConsumption, ( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID as DocumentTypeID, Item.Description as IncurredDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsIncurred, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks, Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName as Location, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) TransactionCost , isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) as CustomAmount, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.NoImpactQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,SET_Rack.RackName ,SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID as CatalogID , SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,INV_ItemDetails.ProductType,INV_ItemDetails.ProductStyle,INV_ItemDetails.GoodsType,POQuantity,SupplierDCQuantity,ActualReceivedQuantity,ShortQuantity,RejectedQuantity , case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) Rate ,CustomDuty,OtherCharges,SalesTax as TaxAmount,CurrencyConversionDate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID,ShipmentNumber ,0 as TaxPercent,0 as CustomDutyPercent , 0 as OtherChargesPercent,ISNULL(NetAmount,0) as NetAmount , case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate is not null and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate != 0 then (ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount,0) / INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate) else 0 end as AmountINDollar,FinishingItemID as FinishItemID ,EndProduct.Description as FinishItemDescription, EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID as FinishCatalogID,EndCatalog.Description as FinishCatalogName,EndCategory.CategoryID as FinishCategoryID ,EndCategory.CategoryName as FinishCategoryName ,IncomeTax,0 as IncomeTaxPercent,ExpectedQuantity,Item.UnitWeight,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ClearingCharges,0 as CurrentStock ,ISNULL(NoofContainers,0) as FreightCharges,FreightCode as ContainerSize ,ISNULL(NetAmount,0) as CMTAmount,ISNULL(Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) as CMTRate,Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as RecipeNo
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left JOIN INV_ItemDetails ON INV_ItemDetails.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_ItemDetails.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID in
(
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location On Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo= @DocumentNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentType
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
)
and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
order by INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID asc
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.TotalAmount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo,CostCenterTo.CostCenterName As CostCenterTo, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IssuanceType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ProductRecipeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ProductQuantity, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsReversed, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalDate, Set_Department.DepartmentName, Set_Location.LocationName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Loan_COGSAmount,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Loan_StockAmount,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Loan_TransactionType ,BLNo,GDNumber,ExchangeRate,NoofContainers
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location On Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo= @DocumentNo and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentType AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1

SELECT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode as DocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as DocumentNo,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate as CurrenyRate ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateDate as CurrencyDate, SET_Currency.CurrencyName,Set_Location.LocationName,(CASE WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode=1 then 'ByAir' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode=2 then 'ByRoad' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ShipViaCode=3 then 'BySea' else '' end ) ShipmentMode ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Comments,LogisticSupplier.CustomerName as LogisticSupplier ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier,INV_StockTransactionHeader.NoofContainers ,(CASE WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FreightTermsCode=1 then 'CFR' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FreightTermsCode=2 then 'FOB' else '' end ) PaymentType ,(CASE WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateType=1 then 'DemandDraft' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateType=2 then 'Ready' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateType=3 then 'TelegraphicTransfer' WHEN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.RateType=4 then 'Cash' else '' end ) PaymentMethod ,BLNo,GDNumber,ClearingAgent.CustomerName as ClearingAgent, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Item.Description as ItemDescription, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QuantityAdjusted, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EmployeeCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.VendorLotNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShipmentNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.WayBillAirBill, INV_StockTransactionDetail.FreightCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoofContainers, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PercentageChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReservationLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID, Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) TransactionCost , isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) as CustomAmount
,SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID as CatalogID , SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName
,isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) Rate ,CustomDuty,OtherCharges,SalesTax as TaxAmount,CurrencyConversionDate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID,ShipmentNumber ,0 as TaxPercent,0 as CustomDutyPercent , 0 as OtherChargesPercent,ISNULL(NetAmount,0) as NetAmount , case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate is not null and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate != 0 then (ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount,0) / INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate) else 0 end as AmountINDollar,FinishingItemID as FinishItemID ,EndProduct.Description as FinishItemDescription, EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID as FinishCatalogID,EndCatalog.Description as FinishCatalogName,EndCategory.CategoryID as FinishCategoryID ,EndCategory.CategoryName as FinishCategoryName ,IncomeTax,0 as IncomeTaxPercent,ExpectedQuantity,Item.UnitWeight,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ClearingCharges,0 as CurrentStock ,ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoofContainers,0) as FreightCharges,FreightCode as ContainerSize ,ISNULL(NetAmount,0) as CMTAmount,ISNULL(Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)*(CASE WHEN ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CurrencyID,0) >0 then INV_StockTransactionHeader.ExchangeRate else 1 end) as CMTRate,Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as RecipeNo ,ISNUll(CustomDuty,0) as CDAmount ,ISNUll(OtherCharges,0) as AdditionalAmount ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue from
INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left JOIN INV_ItemDetails ON INV_ItemDetails.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_ItemDetails.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BillToLocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer LogisticSupplier ON LogisticSupplier.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.LogisticSupplierID AND LogisticSupplier.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ClearingAgent ON ClearingAgent.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID AND ClearingAgent.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location ToLocation On ToLocation.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 WHERE (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode= @DocumentType) AND (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber= @DocumentNo OR @DocumentNo is null) AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1

Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID as LCNumber,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as MarketAmount,TransactionCost as MarketRate, ExchangeRatePercent,ISNULL(CostWithCD,0) As FCRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as ReceivedQty ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_Item.Description,LCItem.Description as IncurredOnID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,Convert(decimal,'0') as TotalBalance from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 inner join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID inner join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID left join INV_Item as LCItem on LCItem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1

Select * from( Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (FinalFullForm.RequisitionNumber)) AS SerialNo, FinalFullForm.StockTransactionID, FinalFullForm.RequisitionNumber, FinalFullForm.TransactionDetailID, FinalFullForm.ItemID,FinalFullForm.ItemName, FinalFullForm.UOMName, FinalFullForm.TransactionQuantity, FinalFullForm.DocumentType, FinalFullForm.AssignedTo, (Case when FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PO' then 'Purchase Order' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PPO' then 'Partial Purchase Order' when FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PGRN' then 'Partial GRN' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='GRN' then 'GRN' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PQA' then 'Partial Qoutation Approve' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='QA' then 'Qoutation Approve' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PVQ' then 'Partial Vendor Qoutation' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='VQ' then 'Vendor Qoutation' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PRFQ' then 'Partial RFQ' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='RFQ' then 'RFQ' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='PRA' then 'Partial Requisition Assign' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='RA' then 'Requisition Assign' When FinalFullForm.ReqStatus ='REQ' then 'Requisition Made' end )as status, FinalFullForm.AssignmentDate,FinalFullForm.DocumentDate from (Select FinalFintab.StockTransactionID, FinalFintab.RequisitionNumber, FinalFintab.TransactionDetailID, FinalFintab.ItemID,FinalFintab.ItemName, FinalFintab.UOMName, FinalFintab.TransactionQuantity, FinalFintab.DocumentType, FinalFintab.AssignedTo, ISNULL(GRNStatus, ISNULL(POStatus, ISNULL(QoutationApprove, isnull(VendorQoutation, isnull(RFQStatus, isnull(AssignmentStatus, 'REQ')))))) as ReqStatus ,FinalFintab.AssignmentDate,FinalFintab.DocumentDate from (Select Fintab.StockTransactionID, Fintab.RequisitionNumber, Fintab.TransactionDetailID, Fintab.ItemID,Fintab.ItemName, Fintab.UOMName, Fintab.TransactionQuantity, Fintab.DocumentType, Fintab.AssignedTo, (Case When GRNStatus > 1 then 'PGRN' when GRNStatus = 1 then 'GRN' when GRNStatus < 1 then null end )as GRNStatus, (Case When POStatus > 1 then 'PPO' when POStatus = 1 then 'PO' when POStatus < 1 then null end )as POStatus, (Case When QoutationApprove > 1 then 'PQA' when QoutationApprove = 1 then 'QA' when QoutationApprove < 1 then null end )as QoutationApprove, (Case When VendorQoutation > 1 then 'PVQ' when VendorQoutation = 1 then 'VQ' when VendorQoutation < 1 then null end )as VendorQoutation, (Case When RFQStatus > 1 then 'PRFQ' when RFQStatus = 1 then 'RFQ' when RFQStatus < 1 then null end )as RFQStatus, (Case When AssignmentStatus > 1 then 'PRA' when AssignmentStatus = 1 then 'RA' when AssignmentStatus < 1 then null end )as AssignmentStatus, Fintab.AssignmentDate, Fintab.DocumentDate from ( Select INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID, INVStockHeader.DocumentNo as RequisitionNumber, INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID, INVStockDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INVStockDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, aspnet_Users.UserName as AssignedTo,
(Select Count(*) From Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status =1
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID ) as AssignmentStatus,
( Select Count(*) From PUR_EnquiryHeader inner Join PUR_EnquiryDetail on PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.FiscalID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID And Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.FiscalID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.FiscalID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status=1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID )as RFQStatus , (Select Count(*) From PUR_QuotationHeader Inner Join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID= PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID= PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID= PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID And PUR_QuotationDetail.status=1 and PUR_QuotationHeader.status=1
inner Join PUR_EnquiryHeader on PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID=PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID=PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID=PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID=PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID And PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status=1 Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID= PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID )as VendorQoutation , (Select Count(*) From PUR_QuotationHeader Inner Join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID= PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID= PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID= PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID And PUR_QuotationDetail.Approved=1 And PUR_QuotationDetail.status=1 and PUR_QuotationHeader.status=1
inner Join PUR_EnquiryHeader on PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID=PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID=PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID=PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID=PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID And PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status=1
Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID= PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID )as QoutationApprove , (Select Count(*) From AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition
Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionDetailID
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID
)as POStatus ,
(Select Count(*) from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID
inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoDetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID
Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionDetailID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentNo = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail invrequisitionDetail on invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND invrequisitionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader invRequisitionHeader on invRequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID=invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID And invRequisitionHeader.CompanyID=invrequisitionDetail.CompanyID And invRequisitionHeader.PeriodID=invrequisitionDetail.PeriodID And invRequisitionHeader.FiscalID=invrequisitionDetail.FiscalID
Where invrequisitionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND invRequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND invRequisitionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND invRequisitionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND invRequisitionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID )as GRNStatus ,Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CreateDate as AssignmentDate ,INVStockHeader.DocumentDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader INVStockHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail INVStockDetail on INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID= INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INVStockDetail.CompanyID= INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INVStockDetail.PeriodID= INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INVStockDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =INVStockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INVStockHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status=1
left Join Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail on Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID= INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID = INVStockDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID = INVStockDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status =1
inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INVStockDetail.ItemID
inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID= INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure
left Join aspnet_Users on aspnet_Users.UserId=Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.UserID
Where INVStockHeader.DocumentTypeID = 175 And INVStockHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID And INVStockHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID And (Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.UserID = @user or @user is null) And INVStockHeader.Status=1 )Fintab )FinalFintab )FinalFullForm )tab {0}

Select * from ( Select ROW_NUMBER() over (order By tab.StockTransactionID)as SerialNo, tab.StockTransactionID, tab.RequisitionNumber, tab.TransactionDetailID, tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.ItemCode, tab.UOMName, tab.TransactionQuantity, tab.DocumentType, tab.AssignedTo, tab.AssignmentDate, tab.DocumentDate, (Case When GRNStatus > 0 then 'Made' when GRNStatus = 0 then 'Pending' end )as GRNStatus, (Case When POStatus > 0 then 'Made' when POStatus = 0 then 'Pending' end )as POStatus, (Case When QoutationApprove > 0 then 'Made' when QoutationApprove = 0 then 'Pending'end )as QoutationApproveStatus, (Case When VendorQoutation > 0 then 'Made' when VendorQoutation = 0 then 'Pending' end )as VendorQoutationStatus, (Case When RFQStatus > 0 then 'Made' when RFQStatus = 0 then 'Pending' end )as RFQStatus, (Case When AssignmentStatus > 0 then 'Made' when AssignmentStatus = 0 then 'Pending' end )as AssignmentStatus, (Case When InvoiceStatus > 0 then 'Made' when InvoiceStatus = 0 then 'Pending' end )as InvoiceStatus, (Case When PaymentStatus > 0 then 'Made' when PaymentStatus = 0 then 'Pending' end )as PaymentStatus ,tab.AssignmentStatusDate ,tab.RFQStatusDate, tab.VendorQoutationDate, tab.QoutationApproveDate, tab.POStatusDate, tab.GRNStatusDate, tab.InvoiceStatusDate, tab.PaymentStatusDate , (Case When PaymentStatus > 0 then 'Close' when PaymentStatus = 0 then 'Open' end ) as FinalStatus from ( Select INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID, INVStockHeader.DocumentNo as RequisitionNumber, INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID, INVStockDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INVStockDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, aspnet_Users.UserName as AssignedTo,

Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID ) as AssignmentStatus, (Select max(Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CreateDate) From Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status =1
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID ) as AssignmentStatusDate,
( Select Count(*) From PUR_EnquiryHeader inner Join PUR_EnquiryDetail on PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.FiscalID=PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID And Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.FiscalID=PUR_EnquiryDetail.FiscalID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status=1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1

inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1

(Select Count(*) From PUR_QuotationHeader Inner Join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID= PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID= PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID= PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID And PUR_QuotationDetail.status=1 and PUR_QuotationHeader.status=1

inner Join PUR_EnquiryHeader on PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID=PUR_QuotationHeader.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID=PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID=PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.FiscalID=PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID And PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status=1 Inner Join Pur_EnquiryRequisition on Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID= PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID
Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID )as VendorQoutationDate, (Select Count(*) From PUR_QuotationHeader Inner Join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID= PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID= PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID= PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID And PUR_QuotationDetail.Approved=1 And PUR_QuotationDetail.status=1 and PUR_QuotationHeader.status=1

Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Requisition-%HO%' )as POStatusDate,

Inner Join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderDetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Where invrequisitionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND invRequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND invRequisitionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND invRequisitionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND invRequisitionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID )as InvoiceStatus,

(Select Count(INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1

inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail invrequisitionDetail on invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID=Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID AND invrequisitionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID AND invrequisitionDetail.CompanyID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID AND invrequisitionDetail.PeriodID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID
inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader invRequisitionHeader on invRequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID=invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID And invRequisitionHeader.CompanyID=invrequisitionDetail.CompanyID And invRequisitionHeader.PeriodID=invrequisitionDetail.PeriodID And invRequisitionHeader.FiscalID=invrequisitionDetail.FiscalID

inner JOin AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail on AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.FiscalID=AR_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status=1
Where invrequisitionDetail.TransactionDetailID=INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID And invrequisitionDetail.StockTransactionID=INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND invRequisitionHeader.StockTransactionID =INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND invRequisitionHeader.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND invRequisitionHeader.PeriodID =INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND invRequisitionHeader.FiscalID =INVStockHeader.FiscalID)as PaymentStatusDate ,Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CreateDate as AssignmentDate ,INVStockHeader.DocumentDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader INVStockHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail INVStockDetail on INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID= INVStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INVStockDetail.CompanyID= INVStockHeader.CompanyID AND INVStockDetail.PeriodID= INVStockHeader.PeriodID AND INVStockDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =INVStockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID =INVStockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INVStockHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status=1
left Join Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail on Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID= INVStockDetail.StockTransactionID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = INVStockDetail.TransactionDetailID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID = INVStockDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID = INVStockDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status =1
inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INVStockDetail.ItemID
inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID= INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure
left Join aspnet_Users on aspnet_Users.UserId=Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.UserID
Where INVStockHeader.DocumentTypeID = 175 And INVStockHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID And INVStockHeader.PeriodID=1 And (Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.UserID = @user or @user is null) And INVStockHeader.Status=1 and INVStockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @TODate )tab )FinalFintab {0}
