select
case when Set_Department.DepartmentName like '%Operation%' then
cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) else null end as OperationHrs , case when Set_Department.DepartmentName like '%Mechanical%' then cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) else null end as MechanicalHrs , case when Set_Department.DepartmentName like '%Electrical%' then cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) else null end as ElectricalHrs ,
case when Set_Department.DepartmentName like '%KE Electric%' then cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) else null end as KEElectricHrs ,
case when Set_Department.DepartmentName not like '%Operation%' and Set_Department.DepartmentName not like '%KE Electric%' and Set_Department.DepartmentName not like '%Electrical%' and Set_Department.DepartmentName not like '%Mechanical%' and Set_Department.DepartmentName not like '%Operation%'
then cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) else null end as OtherHrs,
INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_Department.DepartmentID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity, cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) as TotalTime,HRMS_Set_Shift.Description AS Shift,DATEDIFF(hour, HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeIn,HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeOut) as ProductionHrs, BPP_RecipeHeader.RecipeName,Set_Department.DepartmentName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments from INV_StockTransactionHeader
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID
inner join Stopagesdetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = Stopagesdetail.StockTransactionID inner Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = Stopagesdetail.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
left JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 inner join BPP_RecipeHeader on INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID= BPP_RecipeHeader.ProductCategoryID --inner join EmployeeDetail on EmployeeDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID left join HRMS_Set_Shift on HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ShiftID where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_SelectFinishGoodsData
data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ProductionQty) as ProductionQty,sum(AdjustmentQuantity) as AdjustmentQuantity,sum(LiftingQty) as LiftingQty from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1 and OISTD.status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item item on item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and item.ItemTypeID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate < @FromDate Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item item on item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and item.ItemTypeID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @FromDate
AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) - --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item item on item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and item.ItemTypeID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @FromDate
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID
),0)
as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty , 0 as AdjustmentQuantity, 0 as LiftingQty
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
{0}
union all
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID --bilal //UnCommented By Mustafa AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%')
Inner Join INV_Item item on item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --bilal //UnCommented By Mustafa AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and item.ItemTypeID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate --AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ProductionQty , isnull((Select Sum(case when TransactionImpact is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item item on item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and item.ItemTypeID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1
And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) as AdjustmentQuantity, isnull(( select ABS(sum(TransactionQuantity)) from ( Select ((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item item on item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and item.ItemTypeID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND StockHeaderLifting.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderLifting.ReversalID IS NULL
) as A ), 0) as LiftingQty
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
{0} ) as tab group by ItemID,ItemName,UOMName

data.name: Query_FInishGoodsSummaryLotWise
data.value:
select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ProductionQty) as ProductionQty,sum(AdjustmentQuantity) as AdjustmentQuantity,sum(LiftingQty) as LiftingQty ,LocationName,RackName from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate < @FromDate and OISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and OISTD.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @FromDate and PISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and PISTD.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0)
+ -- GIN ISNULL((Select SUM(CASE WHEN PISTD.ImpactID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN PISTD.ImpactID = 1 THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) WHEN PISTD.ImpactID = 2 THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END ELSE CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END END) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx') AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%GIN%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @FromDate and PISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and PISTD.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0)
+ -- GRN ISNULL((Select SUM(CASE WHEN PISTD.ImpactID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN PISTD.ImpactID = 1 THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) WHEN PISTD.ImpactID = 2 THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END ELSE CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END END) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx') AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%GRN%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @FromDate and StockHeaderProduction.LocationID = StockHeader.LocationID and PISTD.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0)
- --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @FromDate and LISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and LISTD.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID
),0)
as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty , 0 as AdjustmentQuantity, 0 as LiftingQty ,ISNULL(SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName) LocationName,SET_Rack.RackName
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = StockHeader.LocationID left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {1}
union all Select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as ProductionQty, 0,0,LocationName,RackName
from INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID --left JOIN INV_ItemDetails ON INV_ItemDetails.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_ItemDetails.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ClearingAgent ON ClearingAgent.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID AND ClearingAgent.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1
Left Join SET_DocumentApprove on SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus='Approved' Left Join HRMS_Set_Shift on HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID and HRMS_Set_Shift.Status=1 Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' {0}
union all
Select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end
,0,LocationName,RackName
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
Select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty, CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID = 1 THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID = 2 THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END ELSE CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END END
,0,LocationName,RackName
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%GIN%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
Select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty, CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID = 1 THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID = 2 THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END ELSE CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END END
,0,LocationName,RackName
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%GRN%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = StockHeader.LocationID left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
Select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty, 0, (Case When SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end ), LocationName,RackName
from SAL_DispatchHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
{0}
) as tab group by ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,LocationName,RackName

data.name: Query_DetailOfMajorPlantMachinery
data.value:
select SET_ItemCatalog.Description,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity --, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) as Cost , sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as Cost from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID inner join FA_SET_AssetType on FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = INV_Item.EquipmentTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @FromDate {0} group by SET_ItemCatalog.Description,INV_Item.Description
--update INV_Item set EquipmentTypeID = 4 where ItemID in (44614,44545,2488,45114,45113,45290,1921,11739,45035)

data.name: Query_GetDataForInOutDetailReport
data.value:
SELECT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Rack.RackName
,CASE INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID WHEN 2 Then (abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1) ELSE INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END AS Quantity
,CASE INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID WHEN 1 THEN 'Positive' WHEN 2 THEN 'Negative' ELSE NULL END AS Impact
,CASE INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID WHEN 2 Then (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS NegativeQuantity
,CASE INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID WHEN 1 Then (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS PositiveQuantity
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Rack ON SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Loan/Borrow Stock IN - HO' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0}

data.name: Query_JobReport
data.value:
select jobcode ,JobDescription ,DocumentNo ,DocumentType , sum(ControlDebit) - sum(ControlCredit) as Opening, 0 as ControlDebit ,0 as ControlCredit ,ItemID ,ItemName ,DocumentDate ,InventoryItemStatusCode ,UOMName ,Quantity ,0 as TransactionDetailID from ( select distinct '' as jobcode , 'Opening' as JobDescription , '' as DocumentNo, 'Opening' as DocumentType,
Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GIN%Issuance%' or Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GIN%' then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else 0 end as ControlDebit ,Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Return%' then (ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) *-1 else 0 end as ControlCredit
,null as ItemID, '' as ItemName,null as DocumentDate ,'' as InventoryItemStatusCode ,'' as UOMName ,0 as Quantity
,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID inner join ApplicationMenu on SET_DocumentType.MenuID = ApplicationMenu.MenuID and MenuPath in( '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx') inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status = 1 inner join set_job on INV_StockTransactionDetail.jobId = set_job.jobID inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.statuscode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate {0} )as tab group by jobcode ,JobDescription ,DocumentNo ,DocumentType ,ItemID ,ItemName ,DocumentDate ,InventoryItemStatusCode ,UOMName ,Quantity
union all
select distinct set_job.AccountCode as jobcode , set_job.JobDescription , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as Opening, Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GIN%Issuance%' or Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GIN%' then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else 0 end as ControlDebit ,Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Return%' then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else 0 end as ControlCredit ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.description as ItemName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName ,isnull(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0) as Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID inner join ApplicationMenu on SET_DocumentType.MenuID = ApplicationMenu.MenuID and MenuPath in( '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx') inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status = 1 inner join set_job on INV_StockTransactionDetail.jobId = set_job.jobID inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.statuscode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate) {0}

data.name: Query_GetDataLiftingLocationWiseDetailReport
data.value:
select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ProductionQty) as ProductionQty,sum(AdjustmentQuantity) as AdjustmentQuantity,sum(LiftingQty) as LiftingQty from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate < @FromDate Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @FromDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) - --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @FromDate
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID
),0)
as OpeningQty, 0 as ProductionQty , 0 as AdjustmentQuantity, 0 as LiftingQty
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
{0}
union all
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName , 0 as OpeningQty, isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ProductionQty , isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1
And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) as AdjustmentQuantity, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate
) as A ), 0) as LiftingQty
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
{0} ) as tab group by ItemID,ItemName,UOMName

data.name: Query_SugarProductionDispatchReport
data.value:
Select *,(finTab.AvailableForSale - finTab.IssuedToDate) as ClosingBalance from ( select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,UnitWeight,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ReceivedToday) as ReceivedToday,sum(ReceivedToDate) as ReceivedToDate,(sum(tab.OpeningQty) + sum(ReceivedToDate)) as AvailableForSale ,sum(IssuedToday) as IssuedToday,sum(IssuedToDate) as IssuedToDate from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, INV_Item.UnitWeight,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD

INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = OISTD.LocationID --and LocationName like '%Godow%' Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND OISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID AND StockHeaderOpening.StatusCode = 1 And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID,OISTD.LocationID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID --and LocationName like '%Godow%' Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND PISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID,PISTD.LocationID),0) - --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = LISTD.LocationID --and LocationName like '%Godow%'
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND LISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID --And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @Date AND StockHeaderLifting.StatusCode = 1 And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID,LISTD.LocationID ), 0) as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday , 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 and LocationName like '%Godow%'

--4 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName,SET_Location.LocationID,LocationName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = LISTD.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Inner join SET_DocumentType STD on STD.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and STD.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID and STD.status = 1 and STD.DocumentTypeID = 19 --and STD.DocumentType like '%Dispatch - Sugar%' --and LocationName like '%Godow%' Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.StatusCode = 1 --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND LISTD.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate
) as A ), 0) as IssuedToDate

Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 and LocationName like '%Godow%' Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0} ) as tab group by LocationID,LocationName )finTab
Select count(DeliveryOrderNo) as NOS,sum(RemainingLoadingQty) as QtyInTons from (
select t.DeliveryOrderID, t.DeliveryOrderNo, t.DODate, t.referenceno, t.DocumentType, t.CustomerName, t.CityName, SUM(t.STQty) as STQty ,SUM(t.DOQty) as DOQty ,SUM(t.DOafterRev) as DOafterRev , SUM(t.RevQty) as RevQty , SUM(t.RemainingLoadingQty) as RemainingLoadingQty ,SUM(t.ReturnQty) as ReturnQty from (
Select * From ( SELECT DISTINCT [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DODate], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Set_city.CityName, (SUM(ABS(ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity, 0))) - isnull(sum(Reversed.ReversedQuantity),0) ) STQty,
(isnull(sum(Reversed.ReversedQuantity),0) ) ReturnQty, ( Select ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] DODetail where DODetail.DOHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) DOQty , ( Select ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) - abs (ISNULL( sum(ReversedQty ) , 0 ) ) from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] DODetail where DODetail.DOHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) DOafterRev
, ( Select abs (ISNULL( sum(ReversedQty ) , 0 ) ) from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] DODetail where DODetail.DOHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID
) RevQty
,[SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Quantity] - ISNULL((Select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_LoadingPointDetail inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.PeriodID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo and INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID and GateINID not in (Select DocumentNo from SAL_VehicleCancellation where SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType and SAL_VehicleCancellation.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID) where INV_LoadingPointDetail.Status = 1 and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID ),0) as RemainingLoadingQty
FROM [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID in (select StockTransactionID from INV_StockTransactionHeader where Status = 1 and StatusCode = 1) left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join Set_city on Set_city.cityid = AR_SET_Customer.cityid and Set_city.status = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ,isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity),0) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ) Reversed on Reversed.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and Reversed .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and Reversed .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and Reversed .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] WHERE [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and (stopDispatch = 0 or stopDispatch Is null) and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate {0}
GROUP BY [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DODate], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Set_city.CityName
,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID ,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity )Tab WHERE
(DOQty-RevQty) - STQty > 0
)t group by t.DeliveryOrderID, t.DeliveryOrderNo, t.DODate, t.referenceno, t.DocumentType, t.CustomerName, t.CityName
)Final where (Final.RemainingLoadingQty > 0 OR Final.ReturnQty > 0)
