Select Years,SUM(LiftingQty) as LiftingQty,SUM(StockQty) as StockQty, SUM(StockInBaggingHouse) as StockInBaggingHouse from ( Select Distinct Set_Batch.DEscription as Years, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' Inner join SET_DocumentType STD on STD.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and STD.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID and STD.status = 1 and STD.DocumentTypeID = 19 --and STD.DocumentType like '%Dispatch - Sugar%' INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail DOdtl on DOdtl.DOHeaderID = LISTD.SourceHeaderID AND DOdtl.DODetailID = LISTD.SourceLineID AND DOdtl.CompanyID = LISTD.CompanyID AND DOdtl.PeriodID = LISTD.PeriodID
Inner Join SAL_OrderHeader SOHdr ON SOHdr.OrderID = DOdtl.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SOHdr.[CompanyID] = DOdtl.[CompanyID] AND SOHdr.[PeriodID] = DOdtl.[PeriodID] AND SOHdr.[Status] = 1
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' and SOHdr.Season = SAL_OrderHeader.Season and StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate <= @ToDate
) as A
),0) As LiftingQty, 0 as StockQty, 0 as StockInBaggingHouse
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1
inner Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID --AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
Select Years,LiftingQty, StockQty, StockInBaggingHouse from (
Select Distinct Set_Batch.DEscription as Years,INV_Item.ItemID,StockHeader.StockTransactionID, 0 As LiftingQty, isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderOpening.BatchID
Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and OISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID
and StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate <= @ToDate and OISTD.status = 1 Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) as StockQty,
0 as StockInBaggingHouse
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' inner Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeader.BatchID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and StockHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID --AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
) newTab
union all
Select Distinct Set_Batch.DEscription as Years, 0 As LiftingQty, 0 as StockQty,
(isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderProduction.BatchID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and PISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate and StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @ToDate
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) - isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderProduction.BatchID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and PISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 2 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0)) as StockInBaggingHouse
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeader.BatchID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --And StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
)tab Group By Years

data.name: Query_DailyProductionSaleStockPosition
data.value:
Select * from ( select ItemID,ItemName,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ReceivedToday) as TodayProduction,sum(ReceivedToDate) as ToDateProduction,(sum(tab.OpeningQty) + sum(ReceivedToDate)) as TotalProduction ,sum(Issued_LocalToday) as Issued_LocalToday,sum(Issued_LocalToDate) as Issued_LocalToDate ,sum(Issued_ExportToday) as Issued_ExportToday,sum(Issued_ExportToDate) as Issued_ExportToDate ,sum(TerminalTransitToDay) as TerminalTransitToDay,sum(TerminalTransitToDate) as TerminalTransitToDate ,sum(EvaporationLosses) as EvaporationLosses ,sum(FurtherProcess_ToDay) as FurtherProcess_ToDay,sum(FurtherProcess_ToDate) as FurtherProcess_ToDate
from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, INV_Item.UnitWeight,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate < @FromDate Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @FromDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) - --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @Date And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @FromDate
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID ), 0) as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday , 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as Issued_LocalToday, 0 as Issued_LocalToDate, 0 as Issued_ExportToday, 0 as Issued_ExportToDate, 0 as TerminalTransitToDay, 0 as TerminalTransitToDate, 0 as EvaporationLosses, 0 as FurtherProcess_ToDay, 0 as FurtherProcess_ToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate < @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 --{0}
union all
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ReceivedToday,
isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @Date AND StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ReceivedToDate, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate = @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%local%'
) as A ), 0)
+
isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Transfer Tons to Liter'
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) = @FromDate and LISTD.ImpactID = 2 and LISTD.TransactionUOMID = 36
), 0)
as Issued_LocalToday,
isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%local%' ) as A ), 0) + isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Transfer Tons to Liter' Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate and LISTD.ImpactID = 2 and LISTD.TransactionUOMID = 36 ), 0) as Issued_LocalToDate
,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate = @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%local%'
) as A ), 0) as Issued_ExportToday,
isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%local%' ) as A ), 0) as Issued_ExportToDate
,isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 --and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Transfer Tons to Liter'
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) = @FromDate --and LISTD.ImpactID = 2 and LISTD.TransactionUOMID = 36 and LISTD.LocationID = 3 ), 0) as TerminalTransitToDay
,isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 --and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Transfer Tons to Liter' Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate --and LISTD.ImpactID = 2 and LISTD.TransactionUOMID = 36 and LISTD.LocationID = 3 ), 0) as TerminalTransitToDate
,isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Evaporation%' ), 0) as EvaporationLosses
,isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) = @FromDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Further Processing%' ), 0) as FurtherProcess_ToDay
,isnull(( Select Sum(case when LISTD.ImpactID is not null then case LISTD.ImpactID when 1 then LISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) as TransactionQuantity
from INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Further Processing%' ), 0) as FurtherProcess_ToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0} ) as tab group by ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,UnitWeight )finTab

data.name: Query_DailyProductionSaleStockPositionCO2
data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED DECLARE @cpID INT = @CompanyID, @PrID INT = @PeriodID, @StartDate date = @FromDate, @EndDate Date = @ToDate;
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, 1 as HeadingID,'' as Heading, 'Opening Stock' as Customer , 0 as Today --Production ,isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Where OISTD.Status = 1 AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate < @StartDate Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Loss%'
Where PISTD.Status = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate < @StartDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) - --Lifting isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) - sum(isnull(RejectedQuantity,0)) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity ,((inv.LossInTransitQty)) as RejectedQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail inv on inv.StockHeaderID = LISTD.StockTransactionID and inv.StockDetailID = LISTD.TransactionDetailID and inv.CompanyID = LISTD.CompanyID and inv.PeriodID = LISTD.PeriodID and inv.status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @StartDate ) as A ), 0) as ToDate ,0 as ForTheMonth from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @cpID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PrID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate < @EndDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0} union all
--Production Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, 1 as HeadingID,'' as Heading, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as Customer ,isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
--Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID --And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID --And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @EndDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as Today ,isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
--Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID --And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID --And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
--inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between @StartDate and @EndDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID ),0) as ToDate
,isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
--Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID --And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID --And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
--inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND month(StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate) = month(@EndDate) AND year(StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate) = year(@EndDate) Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID ),0) as ForTheMonth from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @cpID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PrID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @StartDate and @EndDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND StockHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--Dispatch tab
select distinct ItemID,ItemName,HeadingID,Heading,Customer,Today,ToDate,ForTheMonth from (
--Dispatch Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName,4 as HeadingID,'Sale / Dispatch' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Customer ,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderLifting.BusinessPartnerID = StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate = @EndDate
) as A ), 0) as Today ,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) - sum(isnull(RejectedQuantity,0)) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity,((inv.LossInTransitQty)) as RejectedQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail inv on inv.StockHeaderID = LISTD.StockTransactionID and inv.StockDetailID = LISTD.TransactionDetailID and inv.CompanyID = LISTD.CompanyID and inv.PeriodID = LISTD.PeriodID and inv.status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderLifting.BusinessPartnerID = StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @StartDate and @EndDate ) as A ), 0) as ToDate
,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) - sum(isnull(RejectedQuantity,0)) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity,((inv.LossInTransitQty)) as RejectedQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail inv on inv.StockHeaderID = LISTD.StockTransactionID and inv.StockDetailID = LISTD.TransactionDetailID and inv.CompanyID = LISTD.CompanyID and inv.PeriodID = LISTD.PeriodID and inv.status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderLifting.BusinessPartnerID = StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND month(StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate) = month(@EndDate) AND year(StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate) = year(@EndDate) ) as A ), 0) as ForTheMonth from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @cpID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PrID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @StartDate and @EndDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--Dispatch With All Customers
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName,4 as HeadingID,'Sale / Dispatch' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Customer ,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1

) as A ), 0) as Today ,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) - sum(isnull(RejectedQuantity,0)) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity,((inv.LossInTransitQty)) as RejectedQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
left join SAL_InvoiceDetail inv on inv.StockHeaderID = LISTD.StockTransactionID and inv.StockDetailID = LISTD.TransactionDetailID and inv.CompanyID = LISTD.CompanyID and inv.PeriodID = LISTD.PeriodID and inv.status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and StockHeaderLifting.BusinessPartnerID = StockHeader.BusinessPartnerID And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @StartDate and @EndDate ) as A ), 0) as ToDate
,isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) - sum(isnull(RejectedQuantity,0)) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) * -1 else ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) end as TransactionQuantity,((inv.LossInTransitQty)) as RejectedQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1

Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @cpID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PrID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @StartDate and @EndDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
) as tab group by ItemID,ItemName
