data.name: Query_SugarProductionDispatchReport_HSM
data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED Select *,(finTab.AvailableForSale - finTab.IssuedToDate) as ClosingBalance from ( select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,UnitWeight,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ReceivedToday) as ReceivedToday,sum(ReceivedToDate) as ReceivedToDate,(sum(tab.OpeningQty) + sum(ReceivedToDate)) as AvailableForSale ,sum(IssuedToday) as IssuedToday,sum(IssuedToDate) as IssuedToDate from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, INV_Item.UnitWeight,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item invitem on invitem.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And invitem.Description like '%SUGAR%' And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal and OISTD.status = 1 Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122
Inner Join INV_Item invitem on invitem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And invitem.Description like '%SUGAR%' And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeaderProduction.ReversalID IS NULL AND PISTD.Status = 1 AND PISTD.IsActive = 1 AND PISTD.status = 1 Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) - --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item invitem on invitem.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And invitem.Description like '%SUGAR%' --And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @Date And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID ), 0) as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday , 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--1
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' --and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate --As per Amin Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ReceivedToday,
0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--2 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday,
isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 --and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @Date AND StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--3 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, isnull(( select ABS(sum(TransactionQuantity)) from ( Select (LISTD.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
) as A ), 0) as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--4 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%return%' then ABS(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) *-1 else ABS(LISTD.TransactionQuantity) end as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate
) as A ), 0) as IssuedToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0} ) as tab group by ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,UnitWeight )finTab
--------------------------------- Production ------------------------------------------ Select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,UnitWeight,sum(ProductionToday) as ProductionToday,sum(ProductionToDate) as ProductionToDate,sum(StockInBaggingHouse) as StockInBaggingHouse From (
--1 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --AND PISTD.LocationID <> 12 And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ProductionToday,
0 as ProductionToDate,
0 as StockInBaggingHouse
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all --2 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as ProductionToday,
0 as ProductionToDate,
(
isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) -
isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 2 And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0)) as StockInBaggingHouse

inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all

-- group by INV_Item.Description, SET_Unitofmeasure.UOMName, SAL_ContractDetail.Rate, SAL_ContractDetail.GrossAmount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, -- AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo, SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate, SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, -- SAL_ContractDetail.BaseAmount, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, -- SAL_ContractHeader.StatusCode -- ,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ReversedQty -- ,SAL_ContractDetail.ReversedQuantity -- ,SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive -- ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity -- ,SAL_DeliveryORderDetail.DODetailID -- ,SAL_DeliveryORderDetail.DOHeaderID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID --) TAB
-- having sum(TAB.Del_Quantity) -sum(TAB.DispatchQty) > 0
Select count(DeliveryOrderNo) as NOS,sum(RemainingLoadingQty) as QtyInTons from (
select t.DeliveryOrderID, t.DeliveryOrderNo, t.DODate, t.referenceno, t.DocumentType, t.CustomerName, t.CityName, SUM(t.STQty) as STQty ,SUM(t.DOQty) as DOQty ,SUM(t.DOafterRev) as DOafterRev , SUM(t.RevQty) as RevQty , SUM(t.RemainingLoadingQty) as RemainingLoadingQty ,SUM(t.ReturnQty) as ReturnQty from (
Select * From ( SELECT DISTINCT [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DODate], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Set_city.CityName, (SUM(ABS(ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity, 0))) - isnull(sum(Reversed.ReversedQuantity),0) ) STQty,
(isnull(sum(Reversed.ReversedQuantity),0) ) ReturnQty, ( Select ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] DODetail where DODetail.DOHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) DOQty , ( Select ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) - abs (ISNULL( sum(ReversedQty ) , 0 ) ) from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] DODetail where DODetail.DOHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) DOafterRev
, ( Select abs (ISNULL( sum(ReversedQty ) , 0 ) ) from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] DODetail where DODetail.DOHeaderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND DODetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DODetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID
) RevQty
,[SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Quantity] - ISNULL((Select SUM(TransactionQuantity) from INV_LoadingPointDetail inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.PeriodID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo and INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID and GateINID not in (Select DocumentNo from SAL_VehicleCancellation where SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType and SAL_VehicleCancellation.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID) where INV_LoadingPointDetail.Status = 1 and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID ),0) as RemainingLoadingQty
FROM [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID in (select StockTransactionID from INV_StockTransactionHeader where Status = 1 and StatusCode = 1) left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID
left join Set_city on Set_city.cityid = AR_SET_Customer.cityid and Set_city.status = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
left join ( select distinct SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ,isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity),0) as ReversedQuantity from SAL_ReverseDetail group by SourceHeaderID,SourceDetailID,SAL_ReverseDetail.[CompanyID],SAL_ReverseDetail.[PeriodID] ) Reversed on Reversed.SourceHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID and Reversed .SourceDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID and Reversed .[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and Reversed .[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] WHERE [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[StatusCode] = 1 AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and (stopDispatch = 0 or stopDispatch Is null) and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DODate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate {0}
GROUP BY [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo], [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DODate], SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, Set_city.CityName
,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID ,SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity )Tab WHERE
(DOQty-RevQty) - STQty > 0
)t group by t.DeliveryOrderID, t.DeliveryOrderNo, t.DODate, t.referenceno, t.DocumentType, t.CustomerName, t.CityName
)Final where (Final.RemainingLoadingQty > 0 OR Final.ReturnQty > 0)
------------------------------------- Year, Lifted and Stock ---------------------------------------
Select Years,SUM(LiftingQty) as LiftingQty,SUM(StockQty) as StockQty, SUM(StockInBaggingHouse) as StockInBaggingHouse from ( Select Distinct Set_Batch.DEscription as Years, isnull(ABS(Sum([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity)),0) AS LiftingQty , --from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch --INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID --AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo --AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID --AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
--INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID --AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID --AND LISTD.Status = 1
--Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID -- And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' ----Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID ----And SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID --INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = LISTD.SourceHeaderID -- AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = LISTD.SourceLineID -- AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = LISTD.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = LISTD.PeriodID
-- Inner Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID -- AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] -- AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 -- Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID -- And Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderHeader.Season
--Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID ----AND LISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID ----AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < Dateadd(Month, Datediff(Month, 0, DATEADD(m, 3,SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate)), 0) ----and StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate --and StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate <= @ToDate --Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID --,LISTD.ItemID
--),0) As LiftingQty, 0 as StockQty, 0 as StockInBaggingHouse
from [INV_StockTransactionHeader] StockHeader
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON StockHeader.[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND StockHeader.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND StockHeader.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID]
INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = StockHeader.[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = StockHeader.[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = StockHeader.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = StockHeader.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID] = StockHeader.[FiscalID] AND StockHeader.[Status] = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_OrderHeader] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[OrderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[Status] = 1
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
inner join [SET_Batch] ON [SAL_OrderHeader].[Season] = [SET_Batch].[BatchID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_Batch].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_Batch].[PeriodID] AND [SET_Batch].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].Description LIKE '%Sugar%' AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
group by SET_Batch.Description
union all
Select Years,LiftingQty, StockQty, StockInBaggingHouse from (
Select Distinct Set_Batch.DEscription as Years,INV_Item.ItemID,StockHeader.StockTransactionID, 0 As LiftingQty, isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID --Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID --And SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderOpening.BatchID
Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' and OISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID --AND StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate < Dateadd(Month, Datediff(Month, 0, DATEADD(m, 3,SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate)), 0) --and StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate <= @ToDate and OISTD.status = 1 Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) as StockQty,
0 as StockInBaggingHouse
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' inner Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeader.BatchID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
) newTab
union all
Select Distinct Set_Batch.DEscription as Years, 0 As LiftingQty, 0 as StockQty,
(isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderProduction.BatchID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' and PISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate and StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @ToDate
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) - isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = 2122
Inner Join INV_Item INVItem on INVItem.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderProduction.BatchID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INVItem.Description like '%SUGAR%' and PISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 2 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0)) as StockInBaggingHouse
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeader.BatchID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --And StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
--UNION ALL
--Select Distinct --Year(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate) as Years, --isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) --from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch --INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID --AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo --AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID --AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
--INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID --AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID --AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID --AND LISTD.Status = 1
--Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID --Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID --And SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID
--Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL --AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate BETWEEN Dateadd(Month, Datediff(Month, 0, DATEADD(m, 3,SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate)), 0) --AND @ToDate
--Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID --,LISTD.ItemID
--),0) As LiftingQty, --isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
--INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID --AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID ----AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID --AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
--Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID --AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID --AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
--Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID --Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID --And SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID
--Where --StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate BETWEEN Dateadd(Month, Datediff(Month, 0, DATEADD(m, 3,SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate)), 0) AND @ToDate --and OISTD.status = 1 --Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID --,OISTD.ItemID
--),0) --as StockQty,
--isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD --INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID --AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID ----AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID --AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 --and PISTD.Status = 1
--Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID --And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID --And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
--Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
--Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID --And SET_Location.Status = 1 --Where --StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID --AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate --Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --,PISTD.ItemID
--),0) as StockInBaggingHouse
--from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader --INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID --Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1
--Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate --AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 --{0}
)tab Group By Years

data.name: Query_DailyIssueReports
data.value:
Select Distinct INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Demandtype, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as EmployeeName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode, Set_Job.JobDescription, IncurredOn.Description as IncurredOn,
--Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, ( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) - (( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1) ) / 100) ) as TransactionCost,
( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) - (( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) AS Amount, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity,
STUFF((SELECT ', ' + GL.CodeCombinationID FROM GL_TransactionDetail GL inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL.TransactionID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL.CompanyID And GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL.PeriodID
WHERE GL.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And GL.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And GL.TransactionType = 'Debit' And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS CodeCombinationID,
STUFF((SELECT ', ' + (Select Description From GL_CodeCombinationDetail Where CodeCombinationID = GL.CodeCombinationID) FROM GL_TransactionDetail GL inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL.TransactionID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL.CompanyID And GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL.PeriodID WHERE GL.TransactionType = 'Debit' And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS CodeDescription , CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID > 0 THEN Set_Job.AccountCode ELSE INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID END GLCode , CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID > 0 THEN (Select Description From GL_CodeCombinationDetail Where CodeCombinationID = Set_Job.AccountCode) ELSE (Select Description From GL_CodeCombinationDetail Where CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID) END GLCodeDescription
from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1 left Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And SET_Department.Status=1 inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.itemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item .Status=1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID= INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode And SET_UnitofMeasure.Status=1
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID AND Set_Job.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Job.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
Left JOin INV_Item as IncurredOn on IncurredOn.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND IncurredOn .Status=1
Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID Where --INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = 28 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0}
Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Demandtype, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID,Set_Job.AccountCode,INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,INV_Item.UnitVolume,INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID,INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, Set_Job.JobDescription,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, IncurredOn.Description, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
Order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate

data.name: Query_SugarProductionDispatchReportForDKSM
data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED Select *,(finTab.AvailableForSale - finTab.IssuedToDate) as ClosingBalance from ( select ItemID,ItemName,UOMName,PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,UnitWeight,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(ReceivedToday) as ReceivedToday,sum(ReceivedToDate) as ReceivedToDate,(sum(tab.OpeningQty) + sum(ReceivedToDate)) as AvailableForSale ,sum(IssuedToday) as IssuedToday,sum(IssuedToDate) as IssuedToDate ,sum(ReturnQtyToday) as ReturnQtyToday, sum(ReturnQtyToDate) as ReturnQtyToDate from ( Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, INV_Item.UnitWeight,
--Production isnull((Select SUM(OISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail OISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderOpening ON StockHeaderOpening.StockTransactionID = OISTD.StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = OISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = OISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = OISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderOpening.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderOpening.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%'
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = OISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderOpening.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND OISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND OISTD.ItemID = 9842 And StockHeaderOpening.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal Group By StockHeaderOpening.CompanyID ,StockHeaderOpening.PeriodID ,OISTD.ItemID
),0) + --adjustment isnull((Select Sum(case when PISTD.ImpactID is not null then case PISTD.ImpactID when 1 then PISTD.TransactionQuantity when 2 then -1 * abs(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND PISTD.ItemID = 9842 And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID),0) - --Lifting isnull((Select ABS(Sum(LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID --AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND LISTD.ItemID = 9842 --And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate < @Date And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal
Group By StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID ,StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID ,LISTD.ItemID ), 0) as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday , 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @EndDateofPreviousFiscal And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--1
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 --and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate --As per Amin Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ReceivedToday,
0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--2 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday,
isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' --AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND StockHeaderProduction.StatusCode = 1 --and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @Date AND StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--3 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' Inner join SET_DocumentType STD on STD.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and STD.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID and STD.status = 1 and STD.DocumentTypeID in (19, 236) --and CAST(STD.DocumentType as varchar(25)) like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
) as A ), 0) as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
union all
--4 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, isnull(( select sum(TransactionQuantity) from ( Select ABS((LISTD.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,LISTD.TransactionDetailID from SAL_DispatchHeader liftingDispatch INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderLifting ON StockHeaderLifting.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID AND StockHeaderLifting.DocumentNo = liftingDispatch.DispatchNo AND StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = liftingDispatch.FiscalID AND StockHeaderLifting.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail LISTD ON LISTD.StockTransactionID = StockHeaderLifting.StockTransactionID AND LISTD.CompanyID = StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID AND LISTD.PeriodID = StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID AND LISTD.FiscalID = StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID AND LISTD.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = LISTD.ItemID And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' Inner join SET_DocumentType STD on STD.DocumentTypeID = liftingDispatch.DocumentTypeID and STD.CompanyID = liftingDispatch.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = liftingDispatch.PeriodID and STD.status = 1 and STD.DocumentTypeID in (19, 236) --and CAST(STD.DocumentType as varchar(25)) like '%Dispatch%Sugar%'
Where StockHeaderLifting.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderLifting.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderLifting.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID --AND LISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' And StockHeaderLifting.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate
) as A ), 0) as IssuedToDate, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.InvoiceableItemFlag = 1 --AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOin SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And INV_Item.Description like '%SUGAR%' AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND StockHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
Union All
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, isnull(sum(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity),0) as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
--SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,tbl_Broker.CustomerName as BrokerName, SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate as DocumentDate -- ,[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderNo as DONo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemName, -- ISNULL(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0)DispatchQty,SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName,
--isnull(SET_Rack.RackName,tbl_Rack.RackName) as RackName, --SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity as ReturnQty
from SAL_ReverseDetail
Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1

),0) -

),0) as ProductionToDate, 0 as StockInBaggingHouse
