(isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderProduction.BatchID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and PISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 1 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate and StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @ToDate
Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0) - isnull((Select SUM(PISTD.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail PISTD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeaderProduction ON StockHeaderProduction.StockTransactionID = PISTD .StockTransactionID AND StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = PISTD.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = PISTD.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = PISTD.FiscalID AND StockHeaderProduction.Status = 1 and PISTD.Status = 1
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StockHeaderProduction.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID --AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish Goods%' AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath like '/Inventory/Transaction/InventoryInOut.aspx')
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = PISTD.ItemID
Left Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeaderProduction.BatchID
Left Join SET_Location On SET_Location.LocationID = PISTD.LocationID And SET_Location.Status = 1 Where StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND StockHeaderProduction.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND PISTD.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and PISTD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND PISTD.LocationID = 12 and PISTD.ImpactID = 2 --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate = @ToDate --And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And StockHeaderProduction.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Group By StockHeaderProduction.CompanyID ,StockHeaderProduction.PeriodID ,PISTD.ItemID
),0)) as StockInBaggingHouse
,0 as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
from INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = StockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = StockHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
--Inner Join SET_PeriodCustom On SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
inner Join Set_Batch On Set_Batch.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Set_Batch.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Set_Batch.BatchID = StockHeader.BatchID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where StockHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StockHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --And StockHeader.DocumentDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate And StockHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND StockHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 {0}
Union All
Select NULL as Years, 0 as LiftingQty, 0 as StockQty, 0 as StockInBaggingHouse, tab1.ReturnQtyToday, tab1.ReturnQtyToDate from (
---- Add New 1 Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_Location.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, isnull(sum(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity),0) as ReturnQtyToday, 0 as ReturnQtyToDate
--SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,tbl_Broker.CustomerName as BrokerName, SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate as DocumentDate -- ,[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderNo as DONo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemName, -- ISNULL(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0)DispatchQty,SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName,
--isnull(SET_Rack.RackName,tbl_Rack.RackName) as RackName, --SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity as ReturnQty
from SAL_ReverseDetail
Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Inner join [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[SourceLineID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[SourceHeaderID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
Inner join [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].FiscalID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].FiscalID and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
Inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and StockHeader.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and StockHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_DispatchHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID and StockHeader.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker on tbl_Broker.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID And tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --And tbl_Broker.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And tbl_Broker.Status = 1
left Join INV_Item On INV_ITem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1
left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = SAL_ReverseDetail.RackID and SET_Rack.Status = 1
left join SET_Rack as tbl_Rack on tbl_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID and tbl_Rack.Status = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch Return - SITE%' and SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0}
Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, INV_Item.UnitWeight, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName ) tab1
Union All ---- add new 2
Select NULL as Years, 0 as LiftingQty, 0 as StockQty, 0 as StockInBaggingHouse, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, tab2.ReturnQtyToDate from (
Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, SET_Location.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,INV_Item.UnitWeight, 0 as OpeningQty, 0 as ReceivedToday, 0 as ReceivedToDate, 0 as IssuedToday, 0 as IssuedToDate, 0 as ReturnQtyToday, isnull(sum(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity),0) as ReturnQtyToDate
from SAL_ReverseDetail
Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Inner join [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[SourceLineID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[SourceHeaderID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[PeriodID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID and [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
Inner join [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].FiscalID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].FiscalID and [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1
Inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader StockHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID and StockHeader.StockTransactionID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and StockHeader.Status = 1
Inner join SAL_DispatchHeader ON StockHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and StockHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and StockHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and StockHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and StockHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID and StockHeader.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer tbl_Broker on tbl_Broker.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID And tbl_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --And tbl_Broker.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And tbl_Broker.Status = 1
left Join INV_Item On INV_ITem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1
left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = SAL_ReverseDetail.RackID and SET_Rack.Status = 1
left join SET_Rack as tbl_Rack on tbl_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID and tbl_Rack.Status = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1
Where SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch Return - SITE%' AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate between DATEADD(Day, 1, @EndDateofPreviousFiscal) and @ToDate {0}
Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, INV_Item.UnitWeight, SET_Location.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName
)tab2
)tab Group By Years
Order by Years desc

data.name: Query_SelectGRNWisePurchase
data.value:
Select Distinct TransactionDetailID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo As GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SET_UnitofMeasure.UomName,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ExciseDuty,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.TaxID,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.OtherTaxID) as TaxID, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * isNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) * isnull(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,isnull(otherTax.TaxRate,0)) / 100 else 0 end As taxAmount, isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) as NetAmount, isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) + Isnull((case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * isnull(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,otherTax.TaxRate) / 100 )else 0 end),0) as ForexValue, AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate ,Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONo ,isnull(( select top 1 CreateDate from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate)ApprovalDate from INV_StockTransactionHeader
inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.status=1
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GRN%' and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
inner Join DocumentTypesGroup on DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID= SET_DocumentType.GroupID
inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemiD AND INV_Item.Status=1 Inner JOin INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID= INV_Item.ItemTypeID AND INV_SET_Category.Status=1
Inner Join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID=INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID and SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1
Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID=INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
Left JOin AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
Left join Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader on Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID AND Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1
left Join AR_SET_Tax on AR_SET_Tax.TaxID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.TaxID AND AR_SET_Tax.Status=1
left Join AR_SET_Tax otherTax on otherTax.TaxID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.OtherTaxID AND otherTax.Status=1
Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Ap_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID And AR_SET_Customer.Status=1
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID {0} Order By GRNNo, DocumentDate

data.name: Query_GRNReturnData
data.value:
select *, (GRNQty - ReturnQuantity) AS RemainingQuantity from ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeId,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,ISNULL(GrnReturnStock.ReturnQuantity,0) AS ReturnQuantity ,ABS(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS GRNQty
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT ISNULL(ABS(SUM(INV_GrnReturnStockDetail.TransactionQuantity)),0) AS ReturnQuantity FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_GrnReturnStockHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_GrnReturnStockDetail ON INV_GrnReturnStockDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_GrnReturnStockHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_GrnReturnStockDetail.CompanyID = INV_GrnReturnStockHeader.CompanyID AND INV_GrnReturnStockDetail.PeriodID = INV_GrnReturnStockHeader.PeriodID WHERE INV_GrnReturnStockHeader.ReversalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_GrnReturnStockHeader.ReversalDate != NULL AND INV_GrnReturnStockHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID ) AS GrnReturnStock
Where [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode = 1 AND ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionHeader].IsReversed, 0) != 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = @SourceHeaderID group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GrnReturnStock.ReturnQuantity ) as TAB

data.name: Query_DailyIssueReportsSSML
data.value:
Select Distinct INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Demandtype, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemName, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as EmployeeName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode, Set_Job.JobDescription, IncurredOn.Description as IncurredOn,
--Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, ( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) - (( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) as TransactionCost,
( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) - (( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) AS Amount, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity,
STUFF((SELECT ', ' + GL.CodeCombinationID FROM GL_TransactionDetail GL inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL.TransactionID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL.CompanyID And GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL.PeriodID
WHERE GL.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And GL.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And GL.TransactionType = 'Debit' And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS CodeCombinationID,
STUFF((SELECT ', ' + (Select Description From GL_CodeCombinationDetail Where CodeCombinationID = GL.CodeCombinationID) FROM GL_TransactionDetail GL inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL.TransactionID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL.CompanyID And GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL.PeriodID WHERE GL.TransactionType = 'Debit' And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS CodeDescription , CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID > 0 THEN Set_Job.AccountCode ELSE INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID END GLCode , CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID > 0 THEN (Select Description From GL_CodeCombinationDetail Where CodeCombinationID = Set_Job.AccountCode) ELSE (Select Description From GL_CodeCombinationDetail Where CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID) END GLCodeDescription ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1 left Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And SET_Department.Status=1 inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.itemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item .Status=1
LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID ANd INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID ANd SET_ItemCatalog.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID= INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode And SET_UnitofMeasure.Status=1
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID AND Set_Job.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Job.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
Left JOin INV_Item as IncurredOn on IncurredOn.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND IncurredOn .Status=1
Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID Where --INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = 28 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} {1}
Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Demandtype, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID,Set_Job.AccountCode,INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,INV_Item.UnitVolume,INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID,INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, Set_Job.JobDescription,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, IncurredOn.Description, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName Order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ASC
--- Query 2
Select Fintab.ItemDescription, SUM(Fintab.Discount) as Discount,SUM(OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty, SUM(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount, Fintab.ItemID,SUM(OpeningBalanceRate) as OpeningBalanceRate From ( select tab.Description as ItemDescription, tab.Discount,
sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty, Sum(TAB.OpeningAmount) - Discount as OpeningAmount,
--case when sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 then 0 else --sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceRate) / sum(Tab.OpeningBalanceQty)
--end as OpeningBalanceRate,
TAB.ItemID ,avg(TAB.TransactionCost)OpeningBalanceRate FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate,
(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End)* INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost --(case when std.TransactionQuantity > 0 then std.TransactionCost else ISNULL(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost) -- END) as OpeningAmount,
ISNULL(((((case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End)* INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1),0)) / 100),0) AS Discount,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID) LocationID ,case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else null end as TransactionCost
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) --GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact
) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description, tab.Discount ) as Fintab group by Fintab.ItemID,Fintab.ItemDescription

data.name: Query_GetGINRecordsForStockReturnReport
data.value:
Select SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID , INV_stockTransactionDetail.SerialNo,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,SET_Location.LocationName, INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, (select top 1 case when TransactionCost = 0 then (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate) ELSE (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity*INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) END) AS ReturnVale, (Select Top 1 INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo From INV_StockTransactionDetail as dtail inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = dtail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = dtail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = dtail.PeriodID WHere dtail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID ) as GINNO, isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) as ApprovedBy ,(case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue is null then [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue else [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue end) as PreparedBy ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName BusinessPartner From INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock Return%' AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_CostCenter ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN SET_Location ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SET_Location.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status = 1
LEFT Join AR_SET_Customer On AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_Get_ElectricityProductionData
data.value:
SELECT StockTransactionID, DocumentDate, SUM(BagaseConsumed) AS BagaseConsumed, MAX(BagasseRate) AS BagasseRate, '' as SteamProduction, SUM(ElectricityProduced) AS ElectricityProduced, ((SUM(BagaseConsumed) * MAX(BagasseRate))/SUM(ElectricityProduced)) UnitCostElectricity
FROM (
SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as BagaseConsumed, 0 AS BagasseRate, SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) AS ElectricityProduced, 2 AS SerialNo
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentType LIKE '%FINISH GOOD%PR%' AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 AND INV_Item.Description LIKE 'Electricity'
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
UNION ALL
SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AS StockTransactionID, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) AS BagaseConsumed, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost AS BagasseRate, 0 as ElectricityProduced, 1 AS SerialNo
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentType LIKE '%RECIPE%TRA%' AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 AND INV_Item.Description LIKE 'Electricity' WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 )
GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost
)DT
WHERE DocumentDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY StockTransactionID, DocumentDate ORDER BY StockTransactionID, DocumentDate ASC

data.name: Query_ProductionCostSheetReport
data.value:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT ISNULL(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,' ') AS UOMName, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AS StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost INTO #RecipeDate
FROM INV_Item
LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 AND SET_UnitofMeasure.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND DocumentType LIKE '%Recipe%Transaction%'
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT ISNULL(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,' ') AS UOMName, INV_Item.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost INTO #ProductionDate
FROM INV_Item
LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 AND SET_UnitofMeasure.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND DocumentType LIKE '%FINISH%GOOD%PR%'
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT 0 as SerialNo, * FROM (
SELECT UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, 1 as Sorting, 'Today' as Heading, SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) AS Amount
FROM #RecipeDate
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY UOMName, Description, DocumentDate
UNION ALL
SELECT UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, 2 as Sorting, 'ToDate' as Heading,
(SELECT SUM(ABS(#RecipeDate.TransactionQuantity)) FROM #RecipeDate WHERE #RecipeDate.DocumentDate <= DT.DocumentDate AND #RecipeDate.ItemID = DT.ItemID) AS Amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM #RecipeDate) AS DT
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY DT.ItemID, DT.UOMName, DT.Description, DT.DocumentDate
UNION ALL
SELECT UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, 3 as Sorting, 'Rate' as Heading, AVG(TransactionCost) AS Amount
FROM #RecipeDate
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY UOMName, Description, DocumentDate
UNION ALL
SELECT UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, 4 as Sorting, 'TodayCost' as Heading, SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) * AVG(TransactionCost) AS Amount
FROM #RecipeDate
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY UOMName, Description, DocumentDate
UNION ALL
SELECT UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, 5 as Sorting, 'ToDateCost' as Heading, (SELECT SUM(ABS(#RecipeDate.TransactionQuantity)) FROM #RecipeDate WHERE #RecipeDate.DocumentDate <= DT.DocumentDate AND #RecipeDate.ItemID = DT.ItemID) * AVG(DT.TransactionCost) AS Amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM #RecipeDate) AS DT
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY DT.ItemID, DT.UOMName, DT.Description, DT.DocumentDate
)OneDT
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 as SerialNo, UOMName, 'Cost per MT' as Description, DocumentDate, Sorting, Heading, SUM(Amount) AS Amount FROM (
SELECT '' AS UOMName, '' as Description, DocumentDate, 6 as Sorting, 'Total Today Cost' as Heading, SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) * AVG(TransactionCost) AS Amount
FROM #RecipeDate
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY DocumentDate
UNION ALL
SELECT '' AS UOMName, '' as Description, DocumentDate, 7 as Sorting, 'Production (MT)' as Heading, SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) AS Amount
FROM #ProductionDate
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY DocumentDate
UNION ALL
SELECT '' AS UOMName, '' as Description, DocumentDate, 8 as Sorting, 'Cost per MT' as Heading,
CASE WHEN SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) > 0 THEN
((SELECT SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) FROM #RecipeDate WHERE DocumentDate = #ProductionDate.DocumentDate) * (SELECT AVG(TransactionCost) FROM #RecipeDate WHERE DocumentDate = #ProductionDate.DocumentDate)) / SUM(ABS(TransactionQuantity)) ELSE 0 END AS Amount
FROM #ProductionDate
WHERE DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY DocumentDate
)SecondDT
GROUP BY UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, Sorting, Heading
ORDER BY SerialNo, UOMName, Description, DocumentDate, Sorting ASC

data.name: Query_ProductionCostSheetSummaryReport
data.value:
-----------------------------------------
SELECT INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost INTO #INV_Production FROM INV_Item
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%FINISH%GOOD%PR%'
LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 AND SET_UnitofMeasure.IsActive = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 --{0}
-----------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------
SELECT INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AS StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost INTO #INV_Recipe FROM INV_Item
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Recipe%Transaction%'
LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 AND SET_UnitofMeasure.IsActive = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 --{0}
-----------------------------------------
SELECT *, CASE WHEN ToDateTotalProductionMT > 0 THEN ToDateCost/ToDateTotalProductionMT ELSE 0 END AS AverageProductionCost,
CASE WHEN ToDateTotalProductionMT > 0 THEN TodayCost/ProductionMT ELSE 0 END AS TodayProductionCostPerMT
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT ItemID, Description, UOMName, @FromDate as DocumentDate,
ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TransactionQuantity) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate = @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) AS TodayConsumption,
ISNULL((SELECT AVG(TransactionCost) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate = @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) AS TodayRate,
ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TransactionQuantity) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate = @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) * ISNULL((SELECT AVG(TransactionCost) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate = @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) AS TodayCost,
ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TransactionQuantity) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate <= @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) AS ToDateConsumption,
ISNULL((SELECT AVG(TransactionCost) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate <= @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) AS ToDateRate,
ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TransactionQuantity) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate <= @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) * ISNULL((SELECT AVG(TransactionCost) FROM #INV_Recipe WHERE DocumentDate <= @FromDate AND ItemID = DT.ItemID),0) AS ToDateCost,
ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TransactionQuantity) FROM #INV_Production WHERE DocumentDate = @FromDate ),0) AS ProductionMT,
ISNULL((SELECT SUM(TransactionQuantity) FROM #INV_Production WHERE DocumentDate <= @FromDate ),0) AS ToDateTotalProductionMT
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, #INV_Recipe.UOMName FROM INV_Item
INNER JOIN #INV_Recipe ON #INV_Recipe.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID
) AS DT
--{0}
GROUP BY ItemID, Description, UOMName
)FINTAB

data.name: Query_GetStorePurchaseRequisitionReport_RSM
data.value:
--DECLARE @CompanyID INT = 1, --@PeriodID INT = 1, --@FiscalID INT = 6; --DROP TABLE #INV_StockDetail
-----------------Current Stock Detail-----------------------
select INV_STH.CompanyID, INV_STH.PeriodID, INV_STH.StockTransactionID, INV_STH.DocumentNo, INV_STH.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_STD.ItemID, case when INV_STD.ImpactID is not null then case INV_STD.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(INV_STD.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(INV_STD.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(INV_STD.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(INV_STD.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end as TransactionQuantity, INV_STH.FiscalID INTO #INV_StockDetail
from INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_STD
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_STH On (INV_STH.StockTransactionID = INV_STD.StockTransactionID) AND INV_STH.CompanyID = INV_STD.CompanyID And INV_STD.PeriodID = INV_STH.PeriodID And INV_STH .Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_STD.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode AND UOM.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_STH.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_STD].LocationID AND SL.Status = 1
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_STH.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_STH.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_STH.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
group by INV_STH.CompanyID, INV_STH.PeriodID, INV_STH.StockTransactionID,INV_STH.DocumentNo, INV_STH.DocumentDate,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,INV_STD.ItemID, INV_STD.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,INV_STH.FiscalID
------------------------------------------
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID ORDER BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID) AS SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, SET_Department.DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate, CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 THEN 'Approved' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 5 THEN 'Inprocess' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 12 THEN 'ReleaseForApprove' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 13 THEN 'PartiallyApproved' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 14 THEN 'Discuss' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 15 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 16 THEN 'Reversed' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 25 THEN 'Closed' ELSE '' END AS DocumentStatus, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, isnull(( select top 1 CreateDate from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) AS ApprovedDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate,
(select ISNULL(sum(TransactionQuantity),0) AS CurrentStock from #INV_StockDetail WHERE #INV_StockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND #INV_StockDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND #INV_StockDetail.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID ) AS CurrentStock,
(select ISNULL(sum(TransactionQuantity),0) AS CurrentStock from #INV_StockDetail WHERE #INV_StockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND #INV_StockDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND #INV_StockDetail.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND #INV_StockDetail.TransactionQuantity < 0 AND #INV_StockDetail.DocumentDate BETWEEN (SELECT DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, StartDate), StartDate) FROM SET_PeriodCustom WHERE FiscalId = @FiscalID) AND (SELECT DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, EndDate), EndDate) FROM SET_PeriodCustom WHERE FiscalId = @FiscalID) ) As LastSeasonConsumed,
(select ISNULL(sum(TransactionQuantity),0) AS CurrentStock from #INV_StockDetail WHERE #INV_StockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND #INV_StockDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND #INV_StockDetail.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND #INV_StockDetail.TransactionQuantity < 0 AND #INV_StockDetail.DocumentDate BETWEEN (SELECT DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(YEAR, -2, StartDate), StartDate) FROM SET_PeriodCustom WHERE FiscalId = @FiscalID) AND (SELECT DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(YEAR, -2, EndDate), EndDate) FROM SET_PeriodCustom WHERE FiscalId = @FiscalID) ) As LastLastSeasonConsumed,
(select ISNULL(sum(TransactionQuantity),0) AS CurrentStock from #INV_StockDetail WHERE #INV_StockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND #INV_StockDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND #INV_StockDetail.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND #INV_StockDetail.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND #INV_StockDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 ) As ThisYearIssuance,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 AND MenuID IN (SELECT MenuID FROM ApplicationMenu WHERE MenuPath LIKE '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 AND INV_SET_Category.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 AND SET_UnitofMeasure.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 AND SET_Department.IsActive = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID {0} ORDER BY DocumentTypeID, DocumentNo
SELECT SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID, SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo, UsersDetail.FullName, SET_Designation.DesignationID, SET_Designation.DesignationName, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate
FROM SET_DocumentApprove
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 AND MenuID IN (SELECT MenuID FROM ApplicationMenu WHERE MenuPath LIKE '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')
INNER JOIN UsersDetail ON UsersDetail.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy
LEFT JOIN SET_Designation ON SET_Designation.DesignationID = UsersDetail.DesignationID AND SET_Designation.Status = 1 AND SET_Designation.IsActive = 1
WHERE SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = @FiscalID {0} ORDER BY SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID DESC
